 local checks=0
 local function check(ok,message) checks+=1 assert(ok,message) end
 local function series(n,interval)
  local c={} for i=1,n do local o=100+math.sin(i/7)*5 c[i]={Time=(i-1)*(interval or 60),Open=o,High=o+2,Low=o-2,Close=o+(i%3==0 and -1 or 1),Volume=i} end return c
 end
 local candles=series(700)
 -- Deep zoom-out is limited by history and by plot width (7 px per candle).
 local minBars,maxBars=V.Limits(#candles,1266)
 check(minBars==10 and maxBars==math.floor(1266/7),"700 candles: zoom-out respects readable spacing: "..maxBars)
 local _,wide=V.Limits(1440,1266) check(wide==math.floor(1266/7),"Long history: zoom-out is limited by plot width at 7 px per candle: "..wide)
 local _,narrow=V.Limits(1440,500) check(narrow==math.floor(500/7),"Narrow plots still allow readable spacing")
 local _,cap=V.Limits(5000,4000) check(cap==V.MaxBars,"Absolute render ceiling")
 local _,small=V.Limits(30,1266) check(small==math.max(40,math.ceil(30*1.15)+5),"Zoom limits follow available history")
 local state={} local live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 check(live.Live and live.Follow and #live.Data<#candles,"Starts following live with a navigable window")
 for _=1,40 do V.Zoom(state,live,1.4,0.5) live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) end
 check(live.Bars==maxBars,"Zoom out reaches the practical limit and stops")
 check(live.Right<=candles[#candles].Time+V.RightMargin*60+1e-6 and #live.Data<=maxBars+3 and live.Interval==60,"Zoom keeps real one-minute candles and a bounded readable count")
 for _=1,40 do V.Zoom(state,live,0.5,0.5) live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) end
 check(live.Bars==minBars,"Zoom in stops at the minimum")
 -- Cursor-anchored zoom keeps the time under the pointer fixed (away from bounds).
 V.Reset(state) local v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 V.Pan(state,v,400,0,1266,300) v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 end
 -- Detached viewport is preserved when candles arrive; following scrolls with them.
 check(not v.Follow,"Panning into history stops following")
 local right,low=v.Right,v.Low
 local grown=table.clone(candles) table.insert(grown,{Time=700*60,Open=100,High=130,Low=90,Close=120,Volume=5})
 local after=V.Resolve(state,grown,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)
 check(after.Right==right and after.Bars==v.Bars,"New candles do not move a detached viewport")
 local follow={} local f1=V.Resolve(follow,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 local f2=V.Resolve(follow,grown,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)
 check(f2.Right-f1.Right==60 and f2.Follow,"Following scrolls by exactly the new candle")
 -- Auto-fit pan moves time only; manual scale pans price too.
 local pan={} local p0=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 V.Pan(pan,p0,100,80,1266,300) local p1=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 check(p1.AutoY and p1.Right<p0.Right,"Auto-fit drag pans time and keeps auto scale")
 -- Y-axis drag: up = taller candles (narrower range), down = shorter; persists until auto-fit.
 V.ScalePrice(pan,p1,-60,300) local tall=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 check(not tall.AutoY and tall.High-tall.Low<p1.High-p1.Low,"Dragging the axis up compresses the range")
 V.Pan(pan,tall,-30,40,1266,300) local moved=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 check(math.abs((moved.High-moved.Low)-(tall.High-tall.Low))<1e-9 and moved.Low>tall.Low,"Manual scale survives panning and pans price")
 local grown2=table.clone(candles) table.insert(grown2,{Time=700*60,Open=100,High=400,Low=10,Close=120,Volume=5})
 local still=V.Resolve(pan,grown2,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)
 check(still.Low==moved.Low and still.High==moved.High,"Manual scale persists across live updates")
 V.ScalePrice(pan,moved,80,300) local short=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 check(short.High-short.Low>moved.High-moved.Low,"Dragging the axis down expands the range")

 for _=1,200 do V.Ease(pan,1/60) end fitted=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 local lo,hi=math.huge,-math.huge

 check(fitted.Low<lo and fitted.High>hi,"Auto-fit contains every visible candle")
 -- Go to live keeps the zoom; reset restores defaults.
 V.Zoom(pan,fitted,1.5,0.5) local zoomed=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 V.Pan(pan,zoomed,600,0,1266,300) zoomed=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 V.GoLive(pan,101) local back=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 check(back.Follow and back.Bars==zoomed.Bars and back.Right==candles[#candles].Time+V.RightMargin*60,"Go to live keeps zoom and follows")
 V.Reset(pan) local reset=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)
 check(reset.Bars==V.DefaultBars.Desktop and reset.Live,"Reset view restores default zoom, auto-fit and live")
 -- Pinch keeps the time under the start midpoint under the current midpoint.
 local pinch={} local pv=V.Resolve(pinch,candles,"1m",0.25,true,{101},360)
 local anchor=V.TimeAt(pv,0.4) V.Pinch(pinch,pv,0.4,0.55,0.6,0,200)
 local pz=V.Resolve(pinch,candles,"1m",0.25,true,{101},360)
 check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(pz,0.55)-anchor)<1e-6 and pz.Bars<pv.Bars,"Pinch zoom anchors to the midpoint")
 -- Bounds and degenerate data.
 V.Pan(state,v,-1e8,0,1266,300) local b=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) check(b.Right<=b.Maximum,"Right bound")
 V.Pan(state,b,1e8,0,1266,300) b=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) check(b.Right>=b.Minimum and #b.Data>0,"Left bound keeps candles visible")
 local one=V.Resolve({},{{Time=0,Open=100,High=100,Low=100,Close=100,Volume=1}},"1D",0.25,false,{100},500)
 check(one.High>one.Low and one.Right>one.Left,"Single flat candle has a valid view")
 -- Ticks are round multiples of the tick size and inside the range.
 local ticks,step=V.PriceTicks(5801.3,5843.9,0.25,6)
 check(step%0.25==0 and #ticks>=3 and ticks[1]>=5801.3 and ticks[#ticks]<=5843.9,"Price ticks")
 for _,t in ipairs(ticks)do check(math.abs(t/step-math.round(t/step))<1e-6,"Price ticks are aligned") end
 local tt,ts=V.TimeTicks(3000,9000,60,6) check(ts>=60 and tt[1]%ts==0,"Time ticks aligned")
 check(candles[1].Time==0 and candles[700].Time==699*60,"Navigation never mutates candles")
 return {Passed=true,Cases=checks,Checks="Zoom limits, cursor/pinch anchoring, follow vs detached, auto-fit pan, manual Y scale, auto-fit easing, go live, reset, bounds, ticks"}
end
ServerScriptService.MarketReign.Particip:
-- One deterministic scheduler; participants never own task loops or modify trade prices.
local Participants={}
Participants.__index=Participants
local RNG={} RNG.__index=RNG
function RNG.new(seed) return setmetatable({State=math.floor(math.abs(seed))%2147483646+1},RNG) end
function RNG:Next() self.State=self.State*48271%2147483647 return self.State/2147483647 end
function RNG:Range(a,b) return a+(b-a)*self:Next() end
function RNG:Int(a,b) return math.floor(self:Range(a,b+1)) end
function RNG:Noise() return (self:Next()+self:Next()+self:Next()-1.5)*2 end
Participants.RNG=RNG
function Participants.new(engine)
 local self=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=engine.Config,Random=RNG.new(engine.Seed),Agents={},Markets={},Regime=nil,
  NextRegime=0,NextNews=80,NextBeliefs=0,News="No synthetic news",NewsUntil=0,Events={}},Participants)
 local r=self.Random
 self:_regime()
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local book=engine.Books[key]
  self.Markets[key]={Fair=book.Reference,Anchor=book.Reference,Impulse=0}
  for i=1,self.Config.MakersPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Maker",i) end
  for i=1,self.Config.ParticipantsPerInstrument do
   local total=0 for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do total+=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 end
   local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen="Liquidity"
   for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do draw-=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 if draw<=0 then chosen=kind break end end
   self:_agent(key,chosen,i)
  end
  if self.Config.WhaleFrequency>0 then for i=1,self.Config.WhalesPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Whale",i) end end
 end
 -- A genuine opening auction: finite makers post, and a participant crosses a quote.
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) end end
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Key==key and a.Kind~="Maker" then
   engine:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) break
  end end
 end
 return self
end
function Participants:_agent(key,kind,index)
 local r=self.Random local maker=kind=="Maker" local whale=kind=="Whale"
 local id="bot:"..key..":"..kind..":"..index
 local budget=r:Int(maker and 350000 or whale and 600000 or 50000,maker and 650000 or whale and 1100000 or 160000)
 local a={Id=id,Key=key,Kind=kind,Budget=budget,Risk=r:Range(0.45,0.85),Limit=r:Int(maker and 140 or whale and 180 or 16,maker and 250 or whale and 350 or 60),
  Speed=r:Range(maker and 1.5 or whale and 28 or 2.5,maker and 4.5 or whale and 100 or 13),Size=r:Int(maker and 3 or whale and 18 or 1,maker and 9 or whale and 60 or 5),
  Bias=r:Range(-0.55,0.55),Belief=self.Markets[key].Fair+r:Noise()*9,Patience=r:Range(4,35),Aggression=r:Range(0.2,0.8),
  Next=r:Range(0.2,18),Stop=r:Int(16,85),Target=r:Int(20,140),Parent=0,ParentSide=1}
 if whale then a.Bias=index%2==0 and -0.3 or 0.3 end
 self.Engine:AddAccount(id,budget,a.Limit,a.Risk,false) table.insert(self.Agents,a)
end
-- Add a new E-mini market on migration without reseeding or advancing the saved exchange.
-- Legacy micro books keep their original participants and economics until positions close.
function Participants:AddMarket(key)
 local e=self.Engine local r=self.Random local first=#self.Agents+1
 local book=e.Books[key]
 self.Markets[key]={Fair=book.Reference,Anchor=book.Reference,Impulse=0}
 for i=1,self.Config.MakersPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Maker",i) end
 for i=1,self.Config.ParticipantsPerInstrument do
  local total=0 for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do total+=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 end
  local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen="Liquidity"
  for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do draw-=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 if draw<=0 then chosen=kind break end end
  self:_agent(key,chosen,i)
 end
 if self.Config.WhaleFrequency>0 then for i=1,self.Config.WhalesPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Whale",i) end end
 for i=first,#self.Agents do
  local a=self.Agents[i] a.Next+=e.Time
  if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) end
 end
 for i=first,#self.Agents do
  local a=self.Agents[i]
  if a.Kind~="Maker" then e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) break end
 end
end
function Participants:_regime()
 local r=self.Random local total=0 for _,regime in ipairs(self.Config.Regimes) do total+=regime.Weight end
 local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen=self.Config.Regimes[1]
 for _,regime in ipairs(self.Config.Regimes) do draw-=regime.Weight if draw<=0 then chosen=regime break end end
 self.Regime=chosen self.Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1
 self.NextRegime=self.Engine.Time+r:Range(self.Config.RegimeSeconds[1],self.Config.RegimeSeconds[2])
 table.insert(self.Events,{Step=self.Engine.Step,Kind="Regime",Name=chosen.Name,Direction=self.Direction})
 if #self.Events>40 then table.remove(self.Events,1) end
end
function Participants:_maker(a)
 local e=self.Engine local b=e.Books[a.Key] local r=self.Random local c=b.Spec local market=self.Markets[a.Key]
 e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key)
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id] if account.Locked then return end
 local p=account.Positions[a.Key] local inventory=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
 local stress=self.Regime.Volatility*self.Config.Volatility+math.min(6,b.Volatility)*0.2
 local center=(b.Last or b.Reference)*0.83+market.Fair*0.17-inventory/a.Limit*(5+stress*5)+r:Noise()*0.7
 local spread=math.max(1,math.floor(stress*0.8+b.Volatility*0.2+r:Range(0,1.4)))
 local liquidity=self.Regime.Liquidity*self.Config.Liquidity
 if self.Engine.Time<self.NewsUntil then liquidity*=0.6 end
 if r:Next()>math.min(1,liquidity*1.7) then return end
 for depth=1,3 do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1}) do
   local size=math.max(1,math.floor(a.Size*liquidity*r:Range(0.55,1.25)*(1-inventory/a.Limit*side*0.8)))
   local tick=math.max(1,math.round(center-side*(spread+(depth-1)*math.max(1,math.floor(stress)))))
   e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type="Limit",Price=tick*c.Tick,Expires=e.Time+a.Speed*2.8})
  end
 end
end
function Participants:_trader(a)
 local e=self.Engine local b=e.Books[a.Key] local r=self.Random local c=b.Spec
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id] if account.Locked then return end
 if r:Next()<0.25 then return end -- varied inactivity, even around news
 local last=b.Last or b.Reference local market=self.Markets[a.Key]
 a.Belief+=(market.Fair-a.Belief)*r:Range(0.02,0.18)+r:Noise()*self.Regime.Volatility*c.Scale*0.6
 local p=account.Positions[a.Key] local inventory=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
 local recent=b.Recent local previous=recent[math.max(1,#recent-r:Int(8,35))] or last
 local momentum=(last-previous)/math.max(3,b.Volatility*8)
 local edge=(a.Belief-last)/math.max(4,b.Volatility*8)
 local signal=a.Bias+r:Noise()*1.3-inventory/a.Limit*1.8
 if a.Kind=="Momentum" then signal+=momentum*r:Range(0.5,1.4)
 elseif a.Kind=="Value" then signal+=edge*r:Range(0.6,1.5)
 elseif a.Kind=="Reversion" then signal-=momentum*r:Range(0.6,1.6) signal+=edge*0.3
 elseif a.Kind=="Protective" then signal+=edge*0.4 end
 if math.abs(signal)<r:Range(0.1,0.55) then return end
 local side=signal>0 and 1 or -1 local size=r:Int(1,a.Size)
 local aggressive=r:Next()<a.Aggression
 if a.Kind=="Whale" then
  if a.Parent>0 then side=a.ParentSide size=math.min(a.Parent,r:Int(4,math.max(5,math.floor(a.Size/3)))) a.Parent-=size
  else
   size=r:Int(math.floor(a.Size/2),a.Size)
   if r:Next()<0.55 then a.Parent=size*r:Int(2,4) a.ParentSide=side size=math.min(a.Parent,r:Int(4,12)) a.Parent-=size end
  end
  aggressive=r:Next()<0.8
 end
 if r:Next()<0.45 then e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key) end
 local request={Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type=aggressive and "Market" or "Limit",Expires=e.Time+a.Patience*r:Range(0.5,1.5)}
 if not aggressive then
  local distance=r:Int(1,math.max(2,math.floor(3+self.Regime.Volatility*3)))
  request.Price=math.max(1,math.round(last-side*distance))*c.Tick
 end
 if a.Kind=="Protective" or (a.Kind~="Maker" and r:Next()<0.16) then request.StopTicks=a.Stop request.TargetTicks=a.Target end
 e:Submit(a.Id,request)
end
function Participants:Step()
 local e=self.Engine local r=self.Random
 e:AdvanceClock(self.Config.StepSeconds)
 if e.Time>=self.NextRegime then self:_regime() end
 if self.Config.NewsFrequency>0 and e.Time>=self.NextNews then
  local sign=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1
  local magnitude=r:Range(8,40)*self.Config.Volatility
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   local m=self.Markets[key] local shock=sign*magnitude*e.Books[key].Spec.Scale*r:Range(0.4,1.5)
   m.Anchor+=shock m.Impulse+=shock*0.1
  end
  self.News=(sign>0 and "Optimistic" or "Cautious").." synthetic outlook"
  self.NewsUntil=e.Time+r:Range(20,55) self.NextNews=e.Time+r:Range(140,420)/self.Config.NewsFrequency
  table.insert(self.Events,{Step=e.Step,Kind="News",Name=self.News,Direction=sign}) if #self.Events>40 then table.remove(self.Events,1) end
 end
 if e.Time>=self.NextBeliefs then
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   local m=self.Markets[key] local c=e.Books[key].Spec
   m.Anchor+=self.Regime.Trend*self.Direction*c.Scale+r:Noise()*self.Regime.Volatility*self.Config.Volatility*c.Scale*0.16
   m.Fair+=(m.Anchor-m.Fair)*0.025+m.Impulse*0.06
   m.Impulse*=0.96
   m.Fair=math.clamp(m.Fair,e.Books[key].Reference*0.6,e.Books[key].Reference*1.4)
  end
  self.NextBeliefs=e.Time+1
 end
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do
  if e.Time>=a.Next then
   if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) else self:_trader(a) end
   local delay=a.Speed*r:Range(0.45,1.65)/self.Regime.Activity
   if a.Kind=="Whale" then delay=a.Parent>0 and r:Range(1.5,6) or delay/math.max(0.0001,self.Config.WhaleFrequency) end
   a.Next=e.Time+delay
   e:ProcessStops()
  end
 end
end
return Participants

-- All fixtures are isolated engines/in-memory stores; this suite never reads or writes player data.
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local R=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
local S=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardService)
local CP=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local Ladder=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)
local Tests={}
local function clone(v)if type(v)~="table"then return v end local r={}for k,x in pairs(v)do r[k]=clone(x)end return r end
local function fresh()
 local e=E.new(Config,981);local f=F.new(e,clone(Ladder),Config)
 e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,100000,.99,false)
 return e,f
end
local function order(e,id,side,price,qty)
 local ok,result=e:Submit(id,{Contract="ES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty or 1,Type=price and"Limit"or"Market",Price=price})
 assert(ok,tostring(result));assert(result.Filled>0 or price,"No execution");return result
end
local function roundtrip(e,f,uid,entry,exit,qty)
 f:Start(uid);local id=f:Owner(uid)
 order(e,"maker",-1,entry,qty);order(e,id,1,nil,qty)
 order(e,"maker",1,exit,qty);order(e,id,-1,nil,qty);f:Evaluate(uid)
 return e.Accounts[id]
end
local function memory()
 local store={Reads=0,Writes=0}
 function store:GetAsync()self.Reads+=1;if self.Fail then error("isolated outage")end;return clone(self.Value)end
 function store:UpdateAsync(_,fn)self.Writes+=1;if self.Fail then error("isolated outage")end;local r=fn(clone(self.Value));if r then self.Value=clone(r)end;return clone(r)end
 return store
end
local function projection(rows,seq,time)return {Rows=rows,WorldId="isolated-world",Sequence=seq,SavedAt=time}end
function Tests.Run()
 local report={}
 local function test(name,fn)local ok,result=pcall(fn);table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and (result or "Passed")or tostring(result)})end
 test("New / open-only accounts excluded; break-even close qualifies",function()
  local e,f=fresh();f:Start("1");local id=f:Owner("1")
  assert(not R.Row(f,"1").Eligible);order(e,"maker",-1,5825);order(e,id,1)
  e.Books.ES.Last=24000;assert(e:Summary(e.Accounts[id]).Unrealized>0)
  assert(R.Row(f,"1").Cents==0 and not R.Row(f,"1").Eligible)
  order(e,"maker",1,5825);order(e,id,-1)
  assert(R.Row(f,"1").Eligible and R.Row(f,"1").Cents==0)
 end)
 test("Negative profit, unlock money and legacy practice excluded",function()
  local e,f=fresh();local a=roundtrip(e,f,"2",5825,5815)
  local p=f:Profile("2");p.ProgressCredit=50000;p.Tiers.F100K={State="Unlocked",Claimed=false,Announced=true}
  local practice=e:AddAccount("player:2:50000",50000,40,.8,true);practice.Realized=999999;practice.History={{Pnl=999999}}
  table.insert(p.Ledger,practice.Id) -- defensive even for an accidentally contaminated old ledger
  f:Evaluate("2");assert(f:Activate("2","F100K"))
  local row=R.Row(f,"2");assert(row.Cents==-50000 and row.Tier=="$100K" and a.Balance==4500)
 end)
 test("Copied lead and followers each count once; duplicate ledger ids ignored",function()
  local e,f=fresh();roundtrip(e,f,"3",5825,5885)
  assert(f:Activate("3","F10K"));assert(f:SetCopy("3",{Enabled=1,Leader="F10K:1",Followers="F5K:1",Sizing="Same"}))

ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ChartPaint:
-- Retained chart primitives: unchanged properties never invalidate Roblox's GUI layout.
-- Only candle geometry animates; execution prices and candle data remain authoritative.
local Pool={} Pool.__index=Pool
function Pool.new(root)
 return setmetatable({Root=root,Parents={},Objects={},Entries={},Moving={},Epoch=0,CanAnimate=false,Duration=0.08},Pool)
end
function Pool:Begin(animate)
 self.Epoch+=1 self.CanAnimate=animate==true
 if not self.CanAnimate then self:Snap() end
 for _,bucket in pairs(self.Parents)do table.clear(bucket.Counts)end
end
-- Without an identity, objects are reused by draw order. With one (a candle's time), the same
-- candle always owns the same objects, so panning can never hand a candle another candle's paint.
function Pool:Get(class,name,parent,identity)
 local bucket=self.Parents[parent]
 if not bucket then bucket={Counts={},Lists={},Keyed={}} self.Parents[parent]=bucket end
 local key=class..":"..name local entry
 if identity~=nil then
  local keyed=bucket.Keyed[key] if not keyed then keyed={} bucket.Keyed[key]=keyed end
  entry=keyed[identity]
  if not entry then
   local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
   entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={},Keyed=keyed,Identity=identity,Key=identity}
   keyed[identity]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
  end
 else
 local index=(bucket.Counts[key]or 0)+1 bucket.Counts[key]=index
 local list=bucket.Lists[key] if not list then list={} bucket.Lists[key]=list end
 entry=list[index]
 if not entry then
  local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
  entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={}}
  list[index]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
 end
 end
 entry.Epoch=self.Epoch
 if entry.Gui and not entry.Object.Visible then entry.Object.Visible=true
 elseif entry.Stroke and not entry.Object.Enabled then entry.Object.Enabled=true end
 entry.Active=true
 return entry.Object
end
function Pool:Props(object,props,identity)
 local entry=self.Entries[object]
 local animate=self.CanAnimate and identity~=nil and identity==entry.Identity
 if identity~=entry.Identity then
  for key in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Values[key]=nil end
  table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
 end
 entry.Identity=identity
 for key,value in pairs(props)do
  if entry.Values[key]~=value then
   entry.Values[key]=value
   if animate and(key=="Position"or key=="Size")then
    entry.Motion[key]={From=object[key],To=value,Elapsed=0} self.Moving[entry]=true
   else object[key]=value end
  end
 end
end
function Pool:Step(dt)
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do
   motion.Elapsed=math.min(self.Duration,motion.Elapsed+dt)
   local t=motion.Elapsed/self.Duration local alpha=1-(1-t)^3
   entry.Object[key]=motion.From:Lerp(motion.To,alpha)
   if t>=1 then entry.Motion[key]=nil end
  end
  if not next(entry.Motion)then self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
end
function Pool:Snap()
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
  table.clear(entry.Motion)
 end
 table.clear(self.Moving)
end
-- `thickness` (default 1 px) is centred on y. Segments are sized to stay inside the row, so the row does
-- not clip: clipping a 1 px-tall row could round to an empty rectangle and hide the whole line.
function Pool:Dash(parent,x,y,width,color,length,z,thickness)
 thickness=thickness or 1
 local row=self:Get("Frame","DashedLineRow",parent)
 self:Props(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y-(thickness-1)//2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,thickness),BackgroundTransparency=1,
  BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=false,ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex})
 local entry=self.Entries[row]
 -- Move a whole dash row with one property write, not hundreds of separate segments.
 if entry.Width~=width or entry.Color~=color or entry.Length~=length or entry.Z~=z or entry.T~=thickness then
  entry.Width=width entry.Color=color entry.Length=length entry.Z=z entry.T=thickness entry.Dashes=entry.Dashes or{}
  local count=math.ceil(width/(length+5))
  for i=1,math.max(count,#entry.Dashes)do
   local mark=entry.Dashes[i]
   if not mark then mark=Instance.new("Frame");mark.Name="DashedLine";mark.BorderSizePixel=0;mark.Parent=row;entry.Dashes[i]=mark end
   mark.Visible=i<=count
   if i<=count then
    local offset=(i-1)*(length+5)
    mark.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,0);mark.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(length,width-offset),thickness)
    mark.BackgroundColor3=color;mark.ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex
   end
  end
 end
 return row
end
-- Keyed objects not drawn for a long time (candles trimmed from history) are destroyed.
function Pool:Prune(age)
 local kept={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Keyed and not entry.Active and self.Epoch-(entry.Epoch or 0)>age then
   entry.Keyed[entry.Key]=nil self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil self.Parents[entry.Object]=nil
   entry.Object:Destroy()
  else table.insert(kept,entry) end
 end
 -- Children of destroyed objects (e.g. a hollow body's inner fill) go with them.
 local alive={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(kept)do
  if entry.Object.Parent then table.insert(alive,entry) else self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
 self.Objects=alive
end
function Pool:Finish()
 if self.Epoch%600==0 then self:Prune(1800) end
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Epoch~=self.Epoch and entry.Active then
   if entry.Gui then entry.Object.Visible=false elseif entry.Stroke then entry.Object.Enabled=false end
   for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
   entry.Active=false table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
  end
 end
end
return Pool

local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService=game:GetService("TeleportService")
local root=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MarketReign")
local Config=require(root.MarketConfig)
local Progression=require(root.ProgressionConfig)
local World=require(script.Parent.WorldService)
local Funded=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Leaderboards=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardService)
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
Funded.Validate(Progression) -- A malformed ladder must stop the server, not corrupt saved profiles.
local function remote(name)
 local old=root:FindFirstChild(name) if old then old:Destroy() end
 local r=Instance.new("RemoteEvent") r.Name=name r.Parent=root return r
end
local requestRemote=remote("OrderRequest") local updateRemote=remote("MarketUpdate")
local world=World.new(Config)
local leaderboard=Leaderboards.new({Studio=world.Studio})
world.CaptureProjection=function(engine)return Ranking.Capture(Funded.new(engine,Progression,Config))end
local oldLeaderboard=root:FindFirstChild("LeaderboardRequest") if oldLeaderboard then oldLeaderboard:Destroy() end
local leaderboardRemote=Instance.new("RemoteFunction") leaderboardRemote.Name="LeaderboardRequest" leaderboardRemote.Parent=root
local market,population,funded local epoch=-1
root:SetAttribute("SessionSeed",nil) root:SetAttribute("Ready",false)
local clients={} local queue={} local sequence=0 local actionLog={}
-- The trading account comes from the player's saved funded profile. New players have no account until
-- they press Start, so joining never creates a starter (or duplicate) account.
local function resolve(player,state)
 if not funded then return end
 funded:Join(state.Uid) funded:Evaluate(state.Uid)
 local p=funded:Profile(state.Uid)
 if p then p.PlayerName=player.Name;p.DisplayName=player.DisplayName end
 state.Owner=funded:Owner(state.Uid) state.Full=true state.PortfolioRevision=nil
end
local function add(player)
 if clients[player] then return end
 clients[player]={Uid=Funded.Key(player.UserId),Contract="ES",Timeframe="1m",Full=true,Tokens=20,TokenTime=os.clock(),
  Seen={},SeenOrder={},Replies={},Subscribed=false,PortfolioAt=0}
 resolve(player,clients[player])
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(add) for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do add(p) end
leaderboardRemote.OnServerInvoke=function(player,tab)
 local state=clients[player]
 if not state or (tab~="Global" and tab~="Server") then return nil end
 -- Read-only endpoint; rate limits are independent of order traffic. No scores/ids accepted.
 local now=os.clock()
 if now<(state.LeaderboardAt or 0) then return {Tab=tab,State="Throttled"} end
 state.LeaderboardAt=now+2
 if not funded or not world:CanRun() then return {Tab=tab,State="Loading",Rows={},Studio=world.Studio} end
 if tab=="Server" then return leaderboard:Server(funded,Players:GetPlayers(),player) end
 local own=Ranking.Row(funded,state.Uid,player)
 return leaderboard:Global(own)
end
-- Portfolio + projection accompany each price batch. Realized and open amounts are one atomic
-- snapshot, including all copy followers, so a closing fill cannot be counted twice by the UI.
local function attachPortfolio(state,packet)
 if not funded then return end
 packet.Events=funded:TakeEvents(state.Uid)
 local profile=funded:Profile(state.Uid)
 local revision=profile and profile.Revision or 0 local now=os.clock()
 packet.Portfolio=funded:View(state.Uid) state.PortfolioRevision=revision state.PortfolioAt=now
 -- Lifetime stats: sent on join/refresh and whenever a counted value changes (a close, a depletion,
 -- a restart). A failure here is isolated from trading and reported to the Stats page.
 local key=funded:StatsKey(state.Uid)
 if state.Full or key~=state.StatsKey then
  local ok,stats=pcall(funded.Stats,funded,state.Uid)
  if not ok then warn("[Get Funded!] Stats unavailable: "..tostring(stats)) end
  packet.Stats=ok and stats or {Error="Stats are temporarily unavailable. Your trades and saved results are not affected."}
  state.StatsKey=key
 end
end
local function emit(player,state)
 if funded then
  local owner=funded:Owner(state.Uid)
  if state.Owner~=owner then state.Owner=owner;state.Full=true end
 end
 local unavailable=not market or world.Mode=="Unavailable" or world.Mode=="Following" or world.Mode=="Loading"
 if unavailable or not state.Owner or not market.Accounts[state.Owner] then
  -- No trading account yet (first join) or the exchange is not ready: send status and portfolio only.
  local packet={StatusOnly=true,CanTrade=not unavailable and world:CanRun(),ConnectionStatus=world:Label(),Replies=state.Replies,NoAccount=not unavailable or nil}
  if not unavailable then attachPortfolio(state,packet) state.Full=false end
  updateRemote:FireClient(player,packet)

 end
 local packet=market:Snapshot(state.Owner,state.Contract,state.Timeframe,state.Full)
 packet.Seed=nil -- The server's future random stream is private.
 packet.CanTrade=world:CanRun() packet.ConnectionStatus=world:Label() packet.PersistenceMode=world.Mode
 -- Quotes/candles/P&L are frequent; unchanged order and trade histories are not resent.
 local orderParts={}
 for _,order in ipairs(packet.Orders)do
  table.insert(orderParts,table.concat({order.Id,order.Contract,order.Protection or "",order.Quantity,order.Price,order.Status},":"))
 end
 local orderSignature=table.concat(orderParts,"|")

  packet.History=nil packet.Fills=nil
 end

 if not state.Full and state.SentOwner==state.Owner and state.SentOrders==orderSignature then

 end

 state.SentRevision=packet.Revision state.SentOwner=state.Owner state.SentOrders=orderSignature
 packet.Regime=population.Regime.Name packet.News=market.Time<population.NewsUntil and population.News or nil
 packet.Speed=Config.SimulationSpeed packet.Replies=state.Replies

local function reply(state,id,ok,message,result,extra)

local allowed={Place=true,Cancel=true,Close=true,Subscribe=true,Account=true,AmendProtection=true,AmendOrder=true,
 Start=true,Activate=true,Restart=true,Purchase=true,Copy=true,Flag=true,Stats=true}
local fields={"ExpectedAccount","Contract","Timeframe","Direction","Quantity","Type","Price","StopTicks","TargetTicks","StopDollars","TargetDollars","ExpectedQuantity","OrderId","Protection","ExpectedPrice",
 "Key","Tier","PurchaseSequence","Enabled","Leader","Followers","Sizing","Stage"}
requestRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,request)
 local state=clients[player]
 if not state or type(request)~="table" then return end
 local now=os.clock() state.Tokens=math.min(20,state.Tokens+(now-state.TokenTime)*6) state.TokenTime=now
 if state.Tokens<1 then return end state.Tokens-=1
 if type(request.Id)~="number" or request.Id%1~=0 or request.Id<1 or request.Id>1e9 or state.Seen[request.Id] then return end
 if not allowed[request.Action] then return end
 -- Whitelist scalar inputs. ExpectedAccount detects a stale view; it never selects an owner.
 -- Execution prices, timestamps and copy links remain server-owned.
 local clean={Id=request.Id,Action=request.Action}
 for _,field in ipairs(fields) do
  local value=request[field]
  if value~=nil then
   if type(value)~="number" and type(value)~="string" then return end
   if type(value)=="number" and (value~=value or math.abs(value)>1e9) then return end
   if type(value)=="string" and #value>(field=="Followers" and 512 or field=="ExpectedAccount" and 64 or 32) then return end
   clean[field]=value
  end
 end
 if #queue>=256 then reply(state,clean.Id,false,"Exchange busy. Please retry.") return end
 state.Seen[clean.Id]=true table.insert(state.SeenOrder,clean.Id)
 if #state.SeenOrder>256 then state.Seen[table.remove(state.SeenOrder,1)]=nil end
 -- Read-only: resend the authoritative Stats packet with the next update (Stats page Retry).
 if clean.Action=="Stats"then state.StatsKey=nil return end
 if clean.Action=="Subscribe"then
  local valid=false for _,tf in ipairs(Config.Timeframes)do if tf[1]==clean.Timeframe then valid=true break end end
  if Config.Contracts[clean.Contract]and valid then
   state.Contract=clean.Contract state.Timeframe=clean.Timeframe state.Full=true state.Subscribed=true
   emit(player,state)
  end
  return
 end
 if not world:CanRun()then reply(state,clean.Id,false,world:Label())emit(player,state)return end
 sequence+=1 table.insert(queue,{Player=player,Request=clean,Sequence=sequence,Epoch=epoch,Owner=state.Owner})
end)
local function process(item)
 local state=clients[item.Player] if not state then return end
 if not world:CanRun() then reply(state,item.Request.Id,false,world:Label(),nil,{Kind=item.Request.Action}) return end
 if item.Epoch~=epoch then reply(state,item.Request.Id,false,"Exchange reconnected. Please submit your order again.")return end
 local req=item.Request local uid=state.Uid
 funded:Evaluate(uid)
 local owner=funded:Owner(uid)
 if state.Owner~=owner then
  state.Owner=owner;state.Full=true
  if req.Action=="Place" or req.Action=="Close" or req.Action=="Cancel" or req.Action=="AmendOrder" or req.Action=="AmendProtection" then
   reply(state,req.Id,false,"Your trading account changed after depletion. Review the selected account and retry.") return
  end
 end
 -- Account lifecycle. Each is idempotent and validated against the saved profile.
 if req.Action=="Start" then
  local ok,message,created=funded:Start(uid)
  local profile=funded:Profile(uid);if profile then profile.PlayerName=item.Player.Name;profile.DisplayName=item.Player.DisplayName end
  state.Owner=funded:Owner(uid) state.Full=true
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Start",Created=created}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Activate" then
  local ok,message=funded:Activate(uid,req.Tier)
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Activate",Tier=req.Tier}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Purchase" then
  local ok,message=world:Purchase(funded,uid,req.Tier,req.PurchaseSequence,function(saved,notice,receipt)
   state.Owner=funded:Owner(uid);state.Full=true
   reply(state,req.Id,saved,notice,nil,{Kind="Purchase",Tier=req.Tier,Receipt=receipt})
  end)

  return

  local ok,message=funded:Restart(uid,req.Tier)

  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Restart",Tier=req.Tier}) return

  local ok,message=funded:SetCopy(uid,req)
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Copy"}) return

ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ChartTools:
-- Chart drawings: stored in time (seconds) and price, never in pixels, so they stay attached to
-- the market when the chart pans, zooms, rescales or resizes. Presentation only.
local Tools={}
Tools.Colors={"Blue","Green","Red","Muted"} -- UI Kit palette keys; resolved by the view
Tools.Opacities={0.08,0.15,0.25,0.4}
Tools.Defaults={Rect={Border="Blue",Fill="Blue",Opacity=0.15},Trend={Border="Blue"},Line={Border="Blue"}}
Tools.SnapRadius={Mouse=14,Touch=24}
Tools.HitTolerance={Mouse=6,Touch=14}
Tools.HandleRadius={Mouse=8,Touch=20}
local nextId=0
function Tools.NewId() nextId+=1 return "d"..nextId.."-"..math.floor(os.clock()*1000)%100000 end
local function copy(d) local r={} for k,v in pairs(d)do r[k]=v end return r end
Tools.Copy=copy
function Tools.CopyList(list) local r={} for i,d in ipairs(list)do r[i]=copy(d)end return r end
-- Gives legacy drawings an id and style so they can be selected, edited and undone.
function Tools.Normalize(d)
 d.Id=d.Id or Tools.NewId()
 local defaults=Tools.Defaults[d.Kind] or {}
 for k,v in pairs(defaults)do if d[k]==nil then d[k]=v end end
 return d
end
function Tools.New(kind,a,b,contract,timeframe)
 local d={Kind=kind,Contract=contract,Timeframe=timeframe,T1=a.Time,P1=a.Price}
 if kind~="Line" then d.T2=b.Time d.P2=b.Price end
 return Tools.Normalize(d)
end
-- Rectangle corners: 1=(T1,P1) 2=(T2,P1) 3=(T2,P2) 4=(T1,P2).
local cornerFields={{"T1","P1"},{"T2","P1"},{"T2","P2"},{"T1","P2"}}
Tools.CornerFields=cornerFields
function Tools.Points(d)
 if d.Kind=="Rect" then
  local pts={} for i,f in ipairs(cornerFields)do pts[i]={Time=d[f[1]],Price=d[f[2]],Part="Corner"..i} end return pts
 elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then return {{Time=d.T1,Price=d.P1,Part="P1"},{Time=d.T2,Price=d.P2,Part="P2"}}
 end
 return {}
end
-- A rectangle's extension handle: the midpoint of its right edge, in the caller's pixel space.
function Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
 return math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),(toY(d.P1)+toY(d.P2))/2
end
-- Nearest candle open/high/low/close within a screen-space radius.
-- toX/toY map time/price to pixels in the same space as x,y.
function Tools.Snap(candles,toX,toY,x,y,radius)
 local best,bestD=nil,radius
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do
  local cx=toX(c.Time)
  if math.abs(cx-x)<=radius then
   for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
    local cy=toY(c[field]) local d=math.sqrt((cx-x)^2+(cy-y)^2)
    if d<=bestD then best={Time=c.Time,Price=c[field],Field=field,X=cx,Y=cy} bestD=d end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end
local function segmentDistance(px,py,x1,y1,x2,y2)
 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1 local len=dx*dx+dy*dy
 local t=len>0 and math.clamp(((px-x1)*dx+(py-y1)*dy)/len,0,1) or 0
 local qx,qy=x1+t*dx,y1+t*dy return math.sqrt((px-qx)^2+(py-qy)^2)
end
Tools.SegmentDistance=segmentDistance
-- Returns {Drawing,Part,Interior} for the topmost drawing under the pointer.
-- The selected rectangle has an "Extend" dot at the midpoint of its right edge (checked first, slightly tighter
-- than corner handles so a small rectangle's corners stay reachable). Other handles belong to the
-- selected drawing only. A rectangle's body is "Slide" (horizontal move).
-- Interiors of unselected rectangles are flagged Interior: the view decides whether a drag there
-- moves the rectangle (mouse) or pans the chart (touch, where rectangles cover a small plot).
function Tools.HitTest(drawings,toX,toY,x,y,tolerance,handleRadius,selectedId,width)
 local extendRadius=math.max(4,handleRadius-2)
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Rect" and d.Id==selectedId then
   local ex,ey=Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
   if math.abs(ex-x)<=extendRadius and math.abs(ey-y)<=extendRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part="Extend"} end
  end
 end
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Id==selectedId then
   for _,pt in ipairs(Tools.Points(d))do
    local hx,hy=toX(pt.Time),toY(pt.Price)
    if math.abs(hx-x)<=handleRadius and math.abs(hy-y)<=handleRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part=pt.Part} end
   end
  end
 end
 local interior
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Line" then
   if math.abs(toY(d.P1)-y)<=tolerance and x>=0 and x<=(width or math.huge) then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then
   if segmentDistance(x,y,toX(d.T1),toY(d.P1),toX(d.T2),toY(d.P2))<=tolerance then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Rect" then
   local x1,x2=math.min(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2))
   local y1,y2=math.min(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2)),math.max(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2))
   local inside=x>=x1-tolerance and x<=x2+tolerance and y>=y1-tolerance and y<=y2+tolerance
   if inside then
    local edge=math.abs(x-x1)<=tolerance or math.abs(x-x2)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y1)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y2)<=tolerance
    if edge or d.Id==selectedId then return {Drawing=d,Part="Slide"} end
    interior=interior or {Drawing=d,Part="Slide",Interior=true}
   end
  end
 end
 return interior
end
-- Applies an edit to `target` from its unmodified `original`.
function Tools.Edit(target,original,part,point,delta)
 for k,v in pairs(original)do target[k]=v end
 if part=="Move" then
  target.T1=original.T1 and original.T1+delta.Time target.P1=original.P1+delta.Price
  if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time target.P2=original.P2+delta.Price end
 elseif part=="Extend" then
  -- Right edge only: the left edge and both price levels stay fixed; the edge never crosses the left
  -- edge (it keeps at least delta.MinWidth seconds, one candle, of width).
  local right=(original.T2 or original.T1)>=original.T1 and "T2" or "T1" local left=right=="T2" and "T1" or "T2"
  target[right]=math.max(point.Time,original[left]+(delta and delta.MinWidth or 0))
 elseif part=="Slide" then
  -- Horizontal only: width (T2-T1), height and both price levels stay exactly as they were.
  target.T1=original.T1+delta.Time if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time end
 elseif part=="P1" or part=="P2" then
  local n=part:sub(2) target["T"..n]=point.Time target["P"..n]=point.Price
 else
  local index=tonumber(part:match("Corner(%d)"))
  if index then
   local f=cornerFields[index] target[f[1]]=point.Time target[f[2]]=point.Price
  end
 end
end
-- Liang-Barsky clip to [0,w]x[0,h]. Rotated GUI objects are not clipped by ClipsDescendants.
function Tools.ClipSegment(x1,y1,x2,y2,w,h)
 local t0,t1=0,1 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
 for _,edge in ipairs({{-dx,x1},{dx,w-x1},{-dy,y1},{dy,h-y1}})do
  local p,q=edge[1],edge[2]
  if p==0 then if q<0 then return nil end
  else
   local r=q/p
   if p<0 then if r>t1 then return nil elseif r>t0 then t0=r end
   else if r<t0 then return nil elseif r<t1 then t1=r end end
  end
 end
 return x1+t0*dx,y1+t0*dy,x1+t1*dx,y1+t1*dy
end
-- Undo/redo of the whole drawing list (small, so snapshots are simple and exact).
local History={} History.__index=History
function Tools.History(limit) return setmetatable({Past={},Future={},Limit=limit or 100},History) end
function History:Record(list)
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
local function restore(list,snapshot) table.clear(list) for i,d in ipairs(snapshot)do list[i]=copy(d) end end
-- Records a snapshot taken before an edit that has already been applied (e.g. a finished drag).
function History:Push(snapshot)
 table.insert(self.Past,snapshot) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
function History:Undo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Past) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Future,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:Redo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Future) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:CanUndo() return #self.Past>0 end
function History:CanRedo() return #self.Future>0 end
-- Candle direction from exact tick counts: 1 up, -1 down, 0 doji. Independent of the viewport.
function Tools.Direction(candle,tick)
 local o=math.round(candle.Open/tick) local c=math.round(candle.Close/tick)
 return c>o and 1 or c<o and -1 or 0
end
return Tools

function View:Ended(ev)

function View:Finish(commit)
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 self.Drag=nil

 self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",nil)

  if not d.Moved and commit then
   local chosen=d.Click or nil

  end

 elseif d.Kind=="Edit"then

  elseif d.Moved then self.History:Push(d.Before);chrome=true end

   else self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end

function View:CommitPlacement()
 local p=self.Placement self.Placement=nil
 local s=self.S local g=self.Geometry
 if not p or not p.B or not g then return end
 -- Ignore a zero-size shape (a click without a second point).
 local w=math.abs(g.X(p.A.Time)-g.X(p.B.Time)) local h=math.abs(g.Y(p.A.Price)-g.Y(p.B.Price))

 local d=Tools.New(p.Kind,p.A,p.B,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)

function View:KeyBegan(ev)

  if DRAW[self.S.Tool]then self.S.Tool="Pan";self.Ctx.refresh();return true end

  self:DeleteSelected();return true

 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Y and not self.Drag then self:Redo();return true

function View:OnMarketUpdate()
 self:UpdateOrderMenu()
 local session=self.Ctx.Session local d=self.Drag
 local message
 if d and d.Kind=="Protection"then
  local held=session.Positions[d.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not held or held.Id~=d.Id or held.Triggered or held[d.Field]~=d.Original then
   self:Finish(false);message="Position or protection changed. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if d and d.Kind=="Order"then
  local o=self:WorkingOrder(d.Id)
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not o or o.Price~=d.Original or o.Quantity~=d.Quantity then
   self:Finish(false);message="Limit order changed or filled. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if self.OrderPending then
  local p=self.OrderPending
  if p.Base~=session.AccountKey or not self:WorkingOrder(p.Id)then self.OrderPending=nil end
 end
 local pending=self.Pending
 if pending then
  local held=session.Positions[pending.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=pending.Base or not held or held.Id~=pending.Id or held.Triggered or not held[pending.Field]then self.Pending=nil end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 return message
end

-- Right-click order menu. The clicked price becomes the order price; the choices depend on where it
-- sits relative to the last traded price: above -> Limit Sell / Stop Buy, below -> Limit Buy / Stop Sell.
-- It shows only those two actions with their price. The quantity is the one selected in Place a Trade
-- (one shared state), and submission uses the terminal's shared order path (same client checks, SL/TP
-- settings, pending state and toasts); the server validates exactly as for the ticket.
local MENU_W,MENU_ROW,MENU_PAD=236,42,8
function View:MenuOptions(price,last)
 if price>last then
  return "Above",{{Dir=-1,Type="Limit",Title="Limit Sell",Gloss="Red"},{Dir=1,Type="Stop",Title="Stop Buy",Gloss="Green"}}
 elseif price<last then
  return "Below",{{Dir=1,Type="Limit",Title="Limit Buy",Gloss="Green"},{Dir=-1,Type="Stop",Title="Stop Sell",Gloss="Red"}}
 end
 return "At",{}
end
function View:OpenOrderMenu(pos)

 if self:Blocked() or not ctx.submitOrder then return false end
 local g=self.Geometry local x,y=self:Local(pos)
 if x<0 or x>g.Width or y<0 or y>g.Height then return false end
 local s=self.S local Market=ctx.Market
 local price=Market.Snap(g.View.High-y/g.Ppp,s.Contract)
 local last=ctx.Session.Prices[s.Contract]
 -- Exactly at the last price there is no limit/stop choice; BUY and SELL place market orders.
 if price<=0 or not last or price==last then return false end
 self.Menu={Contract=s.Contract,Price=price,Pos=pos}
 self:BuildOrderMenu()
 return true
end
function View:CloseOrderMenu()

function View:BuildOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m then return end
 local ctx=self.Ctx local C,Market,s,root=ctx.C,ctx.Market,self.S,ctx.Root
 local frame,button,stroke,round=ctx.frame,ctx.button,ctx.stroke,ctx.round
 for _,o in ipairs({m.Frame,m.Backdrop})do if o and o.Parent then o:Destroy()end end
 local key=m.Contract local last=ctx.Session.Prices[key] or m.Price
 local side,options=self:MenuOptions(m.Price,last)
 if #options==0 then self:CloseOrderMenu() return end
 m.Side=side m.Market=last m.Options=options
 local pxs=Market.Number(m.Price)

 backdrop.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) backdrop.ZIndex=94 backdrop.Parent=root

  local f=m.Frame if not f or not f.Parent then return false end

 end)
 m.Backdrop=backdrop
 local h=MENU_PAD*2+#options*MENU_ROW+(#options-1)*6
 local origin=root.AbsolutePosition
 local px=math.clamp(m.Pos.X-origin.X+6,8,math.max(8,root.AbsoluteSize.X-MENU_W-8))
 local py=math.clamp(m.Pos.Y-origin.Y+6,8,math.max(8,root.AbsoluteSize.Y-h-8))
 local menu=frame(root,"ChartOrderMenu",px,py,MENU_W,h,C.Panel,95);menu.Active=true
 round(menu,12);local edge=stroke(menu,C.Cyan);edge.Thickness=2
 m.Frame=menu
 m.Labels={} m.Buttons={}
 local y=MENU_PAD
 for i,o in ipairs(options)do
  local b=ctx.gloss(button(menu,"Order"..o.Type..(o.Dir>0 and"Buy"or"Sell"),"",MENU_PAD,y,MENU_W-MENU_PAD*2,MENU_ROW,function()
   local n=s.Qty
   local what=string.lower(o.Title).." "..n.." "..key.." @ "..pxs
   if ctx.submitOrder(o.Dir,o.Type,m.Price,n,what)then self:CloseOrderMenu();ctx.refresh()end
  end,C.Raised,C.Text,15,96),o.Gloss)
  b:SetAttribute("Sound","None");b:SetAttribute("Debounce",.4)
  m.Buttons[i]={Button=b,Option=o}
  table.insert(m.Labels,o.Title)

 end

-- Keeps the menu honest while prices move: the choices are rebuilt if the market crosses the clicked
-- price (and it closes if the market sits exactly on it). Changing instrument or opening a popup closes it.
function View:UpdateOrderMenu()

-- Lossless execution state, including FIFO identity and the participants' next random draw.
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local TradeStats=require(script.Parent.TradeStats)
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Encoding=game:GetService("EncodingService")
-- Version 3 introduces E-minis, retained close-only micro books and equity-only failure.
-- Version 4 adds armed stop entry orders, which wait off the order book. An older build would
-- rest them as limits, so it must fail closed on V4. V1-V3 are read unchanged.
-- Version 5 executes player orders off the order book against a saved house counterparty account. An older
-- build would rest player limits in the book again and liquidate the house as a bot, so it fails closed on V5.
-- V1-V4 restore unchanged; player limits they saved in the book come back off-book (see Restore).
-- V6 permanently separates tier access, account instances and Shop receipts. Older writers must
-- refuse it, otherwise they could reset permanent entitlements or spend the wallet twice.
local Checkpoint={Version=6,Readable={[1]=true,[2]=true,[3]=true,[4]=true,[5]=true,[6]=true}}
local function digest(raw)
 local bytes=Encoding:ComputeStringHash(raw,Enum.HashAlgorithm.Sha256)
 return (bytes:gsub(".",function(c)return string.format("%02x",string.byte(c))end))
end
local function clone(value)
 if type(value)~="table"then return value end
 local result={} for key,v in pairs(value)do result[key]=clone(v)end return result
end
local function compatible(saved,current)
 assert(saved.StepSeconds==current.StepSeconds,"Saved market step size differs from configuration")
 local legacy=saved.Contracts.MES~=nil and saved.Contracts.ES==nil
 assert(#saved.ContractOrder==(legacy and 4 or (#current.ContractOrder+(saved.Contracts.MES and 4 or 0))),"Saved instruments differ from configuration")
 local expected=clone(legacy and current.LegacyOrder or current.ContractOrder)
 if not legacy and saved.Contracts.MES then for _,key in ipairs(current.LegacyOrder) do table.insert(expected,key) end end

function Checkpoint.Capture(engine,population)
 local e={Accounts={},Books={},Orders={},Profiles=clone(engine.Profiles or {})}
 for _,key in ipairs({"Seed","Time","Step","NextOrder","NextTrade","TotalVolume","TradeHash","PendingStops"})do e[key]=clone(engine[key])end
 for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder)do
  local a=clone(engine.Accounts[id]);a.OpenOrders=nil
  -- Bot histories are display-only; balances, cash ledger and inventory are retained exactly.
  if not a.Player then a.History={} a.Fills={}end
  table.insert(e.Accounts,a)
 end
 for _,key in ipairs(engine.Config.ContractOrder)do
  local book={}
  for field,value in pairs(engine.Books[key])do if field~="Bids"and field~="Asks"and field~="Spec"then book[field]=clone(value)end end
  e.Books[key]=book
 end
 local ids={}for id in pairs(engine.Orders)do table.insert(ids,id)end table.sort(ids)
 for _,id in ipairs(ids)do table.insert(e.Orders,clone(engine.Orders[id]))end
 local p={RandomState=population.Random.State}
 for key,value in pairs(population)do if key~="Engine"and key~="Config"and key~="Random"then p[key]=clone(value)end end

end
function Checkpoint.Restore(snapshot,currentConfig)
 assert(type(snapshot)=="table"and Checkpoint.Readable[snapshot.Version],"Unsupported saved market format")
 local migrateMicros=compatible(snapshot.Config,currentConfig)
 -- Preserve the saved simulation configuration for exact continuation; presentation cadence may change.
 local config=clone(snapshot.Config)
 config.DailyLossLimit=nil
 config.LegacyOrder=clone(currentConfig.LegacyOrder) config.LegacyContracts=clone(currentConfig.LegacyContracts)
 config.LegacyToCurrent=clone(currentConfig.LegacyToCurrent)
 for _,key in ipairs(config.LegacyOrder) do if config.Contracts[key] then config.Contracts[key].CloseOnly=true end end
 if migrateMicros then
  config.ContractOrder=clone(currentConfig.ContractOrder)
  for _,key in ipairs(currentConfig.LegacyOrder) do table.insert(config.ContractOrder,key) end
  for _,key in ipairs(currentConfig.ContractOrder) do config.Contracts[key]=clone(currentConfig.Contracts[key]) end
  -- Start the new books near the saved market, without relabelling historical executions or volume.
  for old,key in pairs(currentConfig.LegacyToCurrent) do
   local b=snapshot.Engine.Books[old]
   config.Contracts[key].Last=(b.Last or b.Reference)*config.Contracts[old].Tick
  end
 end
 -- MaxCandles only bounds chart history (matching never reads candles), so a restored world adopts the current limit.
 for _,key in ipairs({"BroadcastSeconds","SimulationSpeed","MaxCatchupSteps","MaxCandles","MaxPlayerQuantity","MaxPlayerInventory","MaxPlayerOrders"})do config[key]=currentConfig[key]end
 -- Simulated margin is buying-power policy; contract economics and all saved ledgers stay intact.
 for key,spec in pairs(config.Contracts) do
  local current=currentConfig.Contracts[key] or currentConfig.LegacyContracts[key]
  if current then spec.Margin=current.Margin end
 end
 local data=snapshot.Engine local engine=Engine.new(config,data.Seed)
 for _,key in ipairs({"Time","Step","NextOrder","NextTrade","TotalVolume","TradeHash","PendingStops"})do engine[key]=clone(data[key])end
 for _,a in ipairs(data.Accounts)do
  local account=clone(a);account.OpenOrders={}
  account.LossLimit=account.Base
  assert(not engine.Accounts[a.Id],"Duplicate saved account")
  engine.Accounts[a.Id]=account table.insert(engine.AccountOrder,a.Id)
 end
 for key,fields in pairs(data.Books)do for name,value in pairs(fields)do engine.Books[key][name]=clone(value)end end
 engine.Profiles=clone(data.Profiles or {})
 for uid,profile in pairs(engine.Profiles)do
  assert(type(uid)=="string"and type(profile)=="table"and type(profile.Tiers)=="table"and type(profile.Ledger)=="table","Invalid saved funded profile")
  for _,id in ipairs(profile.Ledger)do assert(engine.Accounts[id],"Saved funded account missing")end
 end
 local prior=0
 for _,order in ipairs(data.Orders)do
  local o=clone(order)
  assert(o.Id>prior and o.Remaining>0 and engine.Accounts[o.Owner]and engine.Books[o.Contract],"Invalid saved resting order")
  prior=o.Id engine.Orders[o.Id]=o engine.Accounts[o.Owner].OpenOrders[o.Id]=true
  -- Armed stop entries and player limits are not book liquidity; the engine rebuilds both indexes from
  -- Orders. Only participant orders rest in the book, so saved player limits migrate off-book here.
  if o.Type~="Stop" and not engine.Accounts[o.Owner].Player then engine:_rest(engine.Books[o.Contract],o) end
 end
 local population=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=config},Participants)
 for key,value in pairs(snapshot.Population)do if key~="RandomState"then population[key]=clone(value)end end
 population.Random=Participants.RNG.new(1);population.Random.State=snapshot.Population.RandomState
 assert(type(population.Random.State)=="number"and population.Random.State>0 and population.Random.State<2147483647,"Invalid saved random state")
 for _,agent in ipairs(population.Agents)do assert(engine.Accounts[agent.Id],"Saved participant account missing")end
 if snapshot.Version<3 then
  local currentAccounts={}
  for _,profile in pairs(engine.Profiles) do for _,entry in pairs(profile.Tiers) do if entry.Account then currentAccounts[entry.Account]=true end end end
  for _,profile in pairs(engine.Profiles) do for _,id in ipairs(profile.Ledger) do if not currentAccounts[id] then engine.Accounts[id].Retired=true end end end
  for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder) do
   local a=engine.Accounts[id]
   if a.Player and not a.Retired and engine:Summary(a).Equity>0 then
    a.Locked=false a.Liquidating=nil
    for _,p in pairs(a.Positions) do if p.Triggered=="Risk liquidation" then p.Triggered=nil end end
   end
   if a.Player then
    for orderId in pairs(clone(a.OpenOrders)) do
     local o=engine.Orders[orderId]
     if config.Contracts[o.Contract].CloseOnly and not o.ReduceOnly then engine:Cancel(id,orderId) end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 if migrateMicros then for _,key in ipairs(currentConfig.ContractOrder) do population:AddMarket(key) end end
 -- Lifetime trading stats (no format change): rebuilt once from saved history for older accounts,
 -- reconciled against the ledger for all others. Idempotent across repeated restores.
 local now=os.time()
 for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder) do local a=engine.Accounts[id] if a.Player then TradeStats.Reconcile(engine,a,now) end end
 engine:Audit()
 return engine,population
end
function Checkpoint.Encode(snapshot)
 local raw=Http:JSONEncode(snapshot)
 local compressed=Encoding:CompressBuffer(buffer.fromstring(raw),Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd,3)
 return {Version=Checkpoint.Version,Codec="zstd-base64",RawBytes=#raw,
  Digest=digest(raw),
  Payload=buffer.tostring(Encoding:Base64Encode(compressed))}
end
function Checkpoint.Decode(record)
 assert(Checkpoint.Readable[record.Version] and record.Codec=="zstd-base64","Invalid checkpoint encoding")
 local compressed=Encoding:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(record.Payload))
 local bytes=Encoding:GetDecompressedBufferSize(compressed,Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
 assert(bytes and bytes==record.RawBytes and bytes<=32000000,"Invalid checkpoint length")
 local raw=buffer.tostring(Encoding:DecompressBuffer(compressed,Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd))
 assert(digest(raw)==record.Digest,"Checkpoint checksum failed")
 return Http:JSONDecode(raw)
end
return Checkpoint

 -- Regression for the price-spike exploit: a player's order used to rest in the participant book, so a
 -- thin moment let a participant sweep into a far limit, printing a candle at the player's price before
 -- makers re-centred (instant profit). Player orders are now off-book: the market must be identical with
 -- or without them, and a far limit fills only if the independent market actually trades there.
 test("Player orders never move the simulated market; far limits fill only when the market reaches them",function()
  local function run(active)
   local c=config() c.ParticipantsPerInstrument=12 c.MakersPerInstrument=3 c.WhalesPerInstrument=2
   local e=Engine.new(c,90210) local bots=Participants.new(e) e:AddAccount("P",5000,5,0.8,true)
   local tick=c.Contracts.ES.Tick local far,above,working,farPrice
   local function px(fraction) return math.round((e.Books.ES.Last or e.Books.ES.Reference)*fraction) *tick end
   for i=1,1600 do
    if active then
     if i==100 then far=select(2,e:Submit("P",{Contract="ES",Direction=1,Quantity=4,Type="Limit",Price=px(0.95)})) end
     if i==150 then above=select(2,e:Submit("P",{Contract="ES",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=px(1.04)})) end
     if i==300 then assert(e:Cancel("P",far.Id)) farPrice=px(0.94) far=select(2,e:Submit("P",{Contract="ES",Direction=1,Quantity=4,Type="Limit",Price=farPrice})) end -- modify
     if i==400 then assert(select(2,e:Submit("P",{Contract="NQ",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopTicks=40,TargetTicks=60})).Filled==1) end
     if i==900 and e.Accounts.P.Positions.NQ then e:Submit("P",{Contract="NQ",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true}) end
     if i==1199 then working=e.Orders[far.Id]~=nil and e.Orders[above.Id]~=nil end
     if i==1200 then e:CancelAll("P") end
    end
    bots:Step()
   end
   return e,e:Audit(),farPrice,working
  end
  local a=run(false) local b,audit,farPrice,working=run(true)
  assert(#a.Trades==#b.Trades and a.TotalVolume==b.TotalVolume,"Player orders changed the number of market trades")
  for i,t in ipairs(a.Trades) do local o=b.Trades[i] for _,field in ipairs({"Step","Price","Quantity","Buyer","Seller","Contract"}) do assert(t[field]==o[field],"Market tape differs at trade "..i..": "..field) end end
  for _,key in ipairs(a.Config.ContractOrder) do for _,tf in ipairs(a.Config.Timeframes) do
   local x,y=a.Books[key].Candles[tf[1]],b.Books[key].Candles[tf[1]] assert(#x==#y,"Candle count differs")
   for i,cdl in ipairs(x) do for _,field in ipairs({"Time","Open","High","Low","Close","Volume"}) do assert(cdl[field]==y[i][field],key.." "..tf[1].." candle "..field.." differs") end end
  end end
  local low=math.huge for _,t in ipairs(b.Trades) do if t.Contract=="ES" and t.Step>=300 and t.Step<=1200 then low=math.min(low,t.Price) end end
  assert(low>farPrice,"Fixture: the market reached the far limit ("..low.." <= "..farPrice.."); choose a farther price")
  assert(working and not b.Accounts.P.Positions.ES,"A far limit filled although the market never reached it")
  assert(b.PlayerFills==2,"Expected exactly the NQ entry and exit fills, got "..tostring(b.PlayerFills))
  return {Trades=#b.Trades,Volume=b.TotalVolume,ESLow=low,FarLimit=farPrice,CashError=audit.CashError,EquityError=audit.EquityError}
 end)

ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.TradeProte:
-- One dollar-to-tick calculation shared by the ticket and authoritative exchange.
-- Dollars are the estimated TOTAL for the requested quantity, excluding slippage.
local Protection={}
function Protection.Resolve(spec,quantity,dollars,entry,direction,field)
 if type(quantity)~="number" or quantity<1 or quantity%1~=0 then return nil,"Choose a positive whole quantity." end
 local unit=spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*quantity
 if type(dollars)~="number" or dollars~=dollars or dollars<=0 or dollars==math.huge or dollars>unit*10000 then
  return nil,"Protection must be a positive dollar amount within 10,000 ticks for this quantity."
 end
 local ticks=math.max(1,math.round(dollars/unit))
 local result={Ticks=ticks,Dollars=ticks*unit,TickDollars=unit}
 if entry then
  local side=(field=="Stop" and -1 or 1)*(direction or 1)
  result.Price=math.round((entry+side*ticks*spec.Tick)/spec.Tick)*spec.Tick
  result.Dollars=math.abs(result.Price-entry)*spec.Multiplier*quantity
 end
 return result
end
return Protection

-- In-memory regression tests only: no DataStore, real player, or live exchange access.
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Checkpoint=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local Ladder=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)
local T={}
local function clone(v)if type(v)~="table"then return v end local r={}for k,x in pairs(v)do r[k]=clone(x)end return r end
local function fresh(tier)
 local e=E.new(Config,4527)
 e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,10000,.99,false)
 local a=e:AddAccount("test",tier.Size,tier.MaxContracts,Ladder.MarginUse,true)
 return e,a
end
local function request(side,qty,price,key)
 return {Action="Place",Contract=key or "NQ",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type=price and "Limit"or"Market",Price=price,StopTicks=40,TargetTicks=120}
end
local function submit(e,id,r)local ok,v=e:Submit(id,r);assert(ok,tostring(v));return v end
local function quote(e,side,qty,price,key)
 local r=request(side,qty,price or Config.Contracts[key or "NQ"].Last,key);r.StopTicks=nil;r.TargetTicks=nil
 return submit(e,"maker",r)
end
-- One participant-to-participant execution at `price`: the only way the market price moves.
local function trade(e,price,key)
 e:AddAccount("t:seller",1e9,10000,.99,false);e:AddAccount("t:buyer",1e9,10000,.99,false);e:CancelAll("maker")
 submit(e,"t:seller",{Contract=key or "NQ",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=price})
 local r=submit(e,"t:buyer",{Contract=key or "NQ",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=price})
 assert(r.Filled==1,"Market trade did not print at "..price)
end
local function rejected(e,a,r,max,reason)
 local ok,msg=e:Submit(a.Id,r)
 assert(not ok,"Excess order accepted")
 assert(msg:find("Maximum currently available: "..max.." "..r.Contract,1,true),msg)
 if reason then assert(msg:lower():find(reason,1,true),msg)end
end
function T.Run()
 local results={}
 local function test(name,fn)local ok,msg=pcall(fn);table.insert(results,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and (msg or "Passed")or tostring(msg)})end
 for i,tier in ipairs(Ladder.Tiers)do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   test(tier.Short..(side==1 and " long "or" short ")..tier.MaxContracts.." NQ with default protection",function()
    assert(tier.MaxContracts==({5,10,25,50,100})[i])
    local e,a=fresh(tier)
    rejected(e,a,request(side,tier.MaxContracts+1),tier.MaxContracts,"limit")
    quote(e,-side,tier.MaxContracts)
    local r=submit(e,a.Id,request(side,tier.MaxContracts))
    assert(r.Filled==tier.MaxContracts and a.Positions.NQ.Quantity==tier.MaxContracts)
    local p=a.Positions.NQ;assert(p.Direction==side and p.Stop and p.Target)
    assert(math.abs(p.Entry-p.Stop)==40*.25 and math.abs(p.Entry-p.Target)==120*.25)
    assert(Config.Contracts.NQ.Multiplier==20 and Config.Contracts.NQ.Tick==.25)
    rejected(e,a,request(side,1),0,"limit")
    e:AdvanceClock(.25);assert(a.Positions.NQ and not a.Liquidating)
    e:Audit()
   end)
  end
 end
 test("Existing exposure, mixed instruments, pending orders and cancellation reserve total capacity",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);quote(e,-1,2);submit(e,a.Id,request(1,2))
  local pending=submit(e,a.Id,request(1,1,20480))
  rejected(e,a,request(1,3),2,"limit")
  submit(e,a.Id,request(1,1,5800,"ES"))
  rejected(e,a,request(1,2),1,"limit") -- 2 held + 1 pending NQ + 1 pending ES = 4; the account total is 5
  assert(e:Cancel(a.Id,pending.Id));assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,"NQ",1,40)==2) -- 5 total minus the ES entry minus 2 held
  e:CancelAll(a.Id);assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,"NQ",1,40)==3)
 end)

  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);submit(e,a.Id,request(1,5,20480));submit(e,a.Id,request(-1,5,20490))
  rejected(e,a,request(1,1),0);rejected(e,a,request(-1,1),0)
  e:CancelAll(a.Id);quote(e,-1,5);submit(e,a.Id,request(1,5))
  local close=request(-1,5,20490);close.ReduceOnly=true;submit(e,a.Id,close)

 test("Balance, equity and margin never reduce the contract limit; only $0 equity stops new entries",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);a.Balance=1000;a.Realized=-4000 -- a $5K account that has lost $4,000
  for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do

  end

 for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   test(key.." wide stops allow entry and dragging; depletion still liquidates "..side,function()
    local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);local spec=Config.Contracts[key];local qty=2
    e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,10000,.99,false)
    local function tickPrice(price)return math.round(price/spec.Tick)*spec.Tick end
    local function mark(price)
     e:CancelAll("maker") -- player fills never consume quotes; clear them so the next print sets the price
     quote(e,side,1,price,key)
     local r=request(-side,1,nil,key);r.StopTicks=nil;r.TargetTicks=nil
     submit(e,"taker",r)
    end
    quote(e,-side,qty,spec.Last,key)
    local entry=request(side,qty,nil,key)
    entry.StopTicks=math.ceil(a.Base*1.5/(qty*spec.Multiplier*spec.Tick))
    assert(submit(e,a.Id,entry).Filled==qty,"Wide initial stop rejected")
    local p=a.Positions[key];local target=p.Target;local initial=p.Stop
    local wide=tickPrice(p.Entry-side*a.Base*2/(qty*spec.Multiplier))
    assert(e:AmendProtection(a.Id,{Contract=key,OrderId=p.Id,Protection="Stop",Price=wide,ExpectedPrice=initial}))
    assert(p.Stop==wide and p.Target==target and math.abs(p.Entry-wide)*qty*spec.Multiplier>a.Base)
    assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,{Contract=key,OrderId=p.Id,Protection="Stop",Price=wide,ExpectedPrice=initial}),"Stale drag accepted")
    local pending=submit(e,a.Id,request(side,1,wide,key))
    mark(tickPrice(p.Entry-side*(a.Base-250)/(qty*spec.Multiplier)))
    assert(e:Summary(a).Equity>0 and e:Summary(a).Equity<e:Summary(a).Margin)
    e:AdvanceClock(.25)
    assert(a.Positions[key]==p and not p.Triggered and not a.Locked and not a.Liquidating,"Positive equity liquidated")
    assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,key,side)==2,"Low equity must not reduce the contract limit (2 held + 1 working of 5)")
    -- Alternate exact-zero and negative-equity boundaries across long/short cases.
    local beyond=side==1 and 0 or 250
    local exit=tickPrice(p.Entry-side*(a.Base+beyond)/(qty*spec.Multiplier))
    mark(exit)
    assert(a.Locked and p.Triggered=="Account depleted" and not p.Stop and not p.Target,"Depletion did not latch")
    local lastTick,volume=e.Books[key].Last,e.Books[key].Volume
    e:AdvanceClock(.25)
    -- Liquidation cancels entries and closes at the market price in one step, off-book.
    assert(not e.Orders[pending.Id] and not a.Positions[key] and a.Locked,"Liquidation must cancel entries and close at the market")
    assert(e.Books[key].Last==lastTick and e.Books[key].Volume==volume,"Liquidation moved the market price")
    rejected(e,a,request(side,1,nil,key),0,"depleted")
    assert(math.abs(a.Balance+beyond)<1e-5 and #a.History==1 and math.abs(a.Realized+a.Base+beyond)<1e-5)
    e:Audit()
   end)
  end
 end

  Changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Replies=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Events=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Preview=preview},Session)

   end

   self.Changed:Fire()return

-- market order when a trade reaches it). The server validates every field.
function Session:Place(key,direction,quantity,orderType,price,stopDollars,targetDollars)

 return self:Send("Place",{Contract=key,Direction=direction,Quantity=quantity,Type=orderType,
  Price=(orderType=="Limit" or orderType=="Stop") and price or nil,StopDollars=stopDollars,TargetDollars=targetDollars})

end

end

  PlaceId=options.PlaceId or game.PlaceId,JobId=options.JobId or game.JobId,Now=options.Now or os.time,

 local seed=self.Studio and self.Settings.StudioReplaySeed or 0

 local engine=Engine.new(self.Config,seed) local population=Participants.new(engine)

end

  -- Optional read model failures must never prevent an exchange save or trading.
  local ok,result=pcall(self.CaptureProjection,self.Engine)
  if ok then projection=result else warn("[Get Funded!] Leaderboard projection unavailable: "..tostring(result)) end
 end

   -- Discard unsaved state after loss of authority. Reacquire and restore the durable record.
   self.Healthy=false self.Mode="Unavailable" self.Status="Reconnecting to the saved exchange"

    local pending=self.PendingPurchase;self.PendingPurchase=nil;self.TransactionBusy=false

   end

  elseif now>=self.NextSave then self:Save(false) return end

 self.Closing=true

  repeat
   if self:Save(true)then return true end
   if not self.Lease.Owned or self.Now()>=self.Lease.Record.LeaseUntil then break end
   task.wait(1)
  until os.clock()>=deadline
 end
 return self.Mode=="Local"
end

 return {Balance=a.Balance,Equity=a.Balance+unrealized,Unrealized=unrealized,Session=a.Balance+unrealized-a.Base,
  Allowance=math.max(0,a.Balance+unrealized),Count=count,Margin=margin}

function Engine:Exposure(a,key,side,qty)

  local p=a.Positions[symbol] local net=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
  local buy,sell=0,0
  for _,id in ipairs(sortedKeys(a.OpenOrders)) do
   local o=self.Orders[id]
   if o and not o.ReduceOnly and o.Contract==symbol then if o.Direction==1 then buy+=o.Remaining else sell+=o.Remaining end end
  end
  if symbol==key then if side==1 then buy+=qty else sell+=qty end end

-- Maximum additional order in this direction, reserving worst-case independent entry fills.

-- Player sizing is the account's contract limit only (the tier's MaxContracts, 5 on $5K), counted across
-- positions and working entries in every instrument. Balance, equity and simulated margin never reduce
-- it: a $5K account that has lost $4,000 can still trade 5 contracts while it is active. A depleted
-- (locked) account cannot open anything; Submit and Snapshot enforce that separately.
function Engine:OrderCapacity(a,key,side,stopTicks,excludeOrder)
 if self:Summary(a).Equity<=0 then return 0,"Account equity reached $0." end -- failure rule: depletes on the next step

 for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local p=a.Positions[symbol] local position=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
  local buy,sell=0,0
  for id in pairs(a.OpenOrders) do
   local o=self.Orders[id]
   if id~=excludeOrder and o and not o.ReduceOnly and o.Contract==symbol then
    if o.Direction==1 then buy+=o.Remaining else sell+=o.Remaining end
   end
  end
  if symbol==key then net=position;same=side==1 and buy or sell;opposite=side==1 and sell or buy
  else otherCount+=math.max(math.abs(position+buy),math.abs(position-sell)) end

 local limit=math.min(a.Limit,self.Config.MaxPlayerInventory)

 if math.abs(net-side*opposite)>allowed then return 0,reason end
 local maximum=math.max(0,math.floor(allowed-side*net-same))
 if maximum>self.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity then maximum=self.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity;reason="Per-order quantity limit." end
 return maximum,reason
end
function Engine:CapacityMessage(a,key,side,stopTicks)
 local maximum,reason=self:OrderCapacity(a,key,side,stopTicks)
 return reason.." Maximum currently available: "..maximum.." "..key.."."
end
-- Armed stop entries by contract. Derived from Orders (never saved), so a restored world rebuilds it.
function Engine:_stopIndex()

  self.Stops={}
  for id,o in pairs(self.Orders) do
   if o.Type=="Stop" then self.Stops[o.Contract]=self.Stops[o.Contract] or {} self.Stops[o.Contract][id]=true end
  end

 return self.Stops
end
function Engine:_retire(o,status)

 o.Status=status self.Accounts[o.Owner].OpenOrders[o.Id]=nil
 self.Orders[o.Id]=nil

 if #self.OrderArchive>self.Config.MaxOrderHistory then table.remove(self.OrderArchive,1) end
end
function Engine:Cancel(owner,id)
 local o=self.Orders[id]
 if not o or o.Owner~=owner then return false,"Order is no longer working." end
 o.Cancelled+=o.Remaining o.Remaining=0 self:_retire(o,"Cancelled")

end
function Engine:CancelAll(owner,key)

end
function Engine:_cleanBook(b)

  for i=#side,1,-1 do
   local level=side[i] local quantity=0
   for j=#level.Orders,1,-1 do
    local o=level.Orders[j]
    if o.Remaining<=0 then table.remove(level.Orders,j) else quantity+=o.Remaining end
   end
   level.Quantity=quantity if quantity==0 then table.remove(side,i) end

end
function Engine:_rest(b,o)

  if (o.Price-l.Price)*o.Direction>0 then at=i break end

end
function Engine:_fillAccount(o,price,qty,tradeId)

  if a.Player and (type(a.Stats)~="table" or a.Stats.V~=TradeStats.Version or a.Stats.DayV~=1) then TradeStats.Reconcile(self,a,os.time()) end

  if o.StopTicks then p.Stop=math.round((p.Entry-side*o.StopTicks*b.Spec.Tick)/b.Spec.Tick)*b.Spec.Tick end

-- Player execution is off-book. The simulated market (every price, candle and volume bar) comes only
-- from participant orders matched in the book. A player's order never enters that book, never consumes
-- its liquidity and never prints a trade, so placing, changing, cancelling or filling it cannot move the
-- market price or create a candle. Fills are taken against the independent price feed:
--  * market orders (including SL, closes, liquidation and triggered stop entries) fill at the current
--    touch: best ask to buy, best bid to sell, or the last trade when that side of the book is empty;
--  * a marketable limit fills at the touch (its price or better); otherwise it waits off-book and fills
--    at its own limit price once a market trade reaches it (buy: trade at or below the limit;
--    sell: trade at or above it);
--  * a take profit fills at its target price once a trade reaches the target.
-- The house account is the counterparty of every player fill, so the double-entry cash ledger,
-- inventory and total P&L still reconcile exactly in Audit.
Engine.HouseId="house:player-fills"
function Engine:_house()
 local h=self.Accounts[Engine.HouseId]
 if not h then h=self:AddAccount(Engine.HouseId,0,1e9,1,false) h.House=true end
 return h
end
function Engine:_touch(b,side)
 local level=(side==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids)[1]
 return level and level.Price or b.Last or b.Reference
end
-- Working player limits by contract. Derived from Orders (never saved), so a restored world rebuilds it,
-- including limits saved by an older build that still rested player orders in the book.
function Engine:_restingIndex()
 if not self.Resting then
  self.Resting={}
  for id,o in pairs(self.Orders) do
   local a=self.Accounts[o.Owner]
   if o.Type=="Limit" and a and a.Player then self.Resting[o.Contract]=self.Resting[o.Contract] or {} self.Resting[o.Contract][id]=true end
  end
 end
 return self.Resting
end
function Engine:_playerFill(o,ticks,qty)
 local b=self.Books[o.Contract]
 self.NextTrade+=1 -- fill ids share the trade sequence so history/stats ids stay monotonic; no tape entry
 local price=ticks*b.Spec.Tick
 local house=self:_house()
 local mirror={Id=o.Id,Owner=house.Id,Contract=o.Contract,Direction=-o.Direction,Remaining=qty,Filled=0,Notional=0,Reference=o.Reference}
 self:_fillAccount(o,price,qty,self.NextTrade)
 self:_fillAccount(mirror,price,qty,self.NextTrade)
