end
-- A market trade at `tick` fills every waiting player limit it reaches, in order-id sequence, at the
-- limit price. The contract cap is re-checked at fill time, so a waiting order can never fill past it.
function Engine:_fillResting(b,tick)
 local list=self:_restingIndex()[b.Key]
 if not list or not next(list) then return end
 local ready={}
 for id in pairs(list) do local o=self.Orders[id] if o and (o.Price-tick)*o.Direction>=0 then table.insert(ready,id) end end
 if #ready==0 then return end
 table.sort(ready)
 for _,id in ipairs(ready) do
  local o=self.Orders[id]
  if o and o.Remaining>0 then
   local a=self.Accounts[o.Owner] local p=a.Positions[o.Contract]
   local qty,status=o.Remaining,nil
   if o.ReduceOnly then qty=(p and p.Direction~=o.Direction) and math.min(qty,p.Quantity) or 0
   elseif a.Locked or a.Liquidating then qty=0 status="Account depleted"
   elseif self:OrderCapacity(a,o.Contract,o.Direction,o.StopTicks,o.Id)<o.Remaining then qty=0 status="Contract limit reached" end
   if qty>0 then self:_playerFill(o,o.Price,qty) end
   if o.Remaining==0 then self:_retire(o,"Filled")
   elseif qty==0 or o.ReduceOnly then o.Cancelled+=o.Remaining o.Remaining=0 self:_retire(o,status or "Cancelled") end
   a.Revision+=1
  end
 end
end
function Engine:_playerOrder(a,b,o,internal)
 local side=o.Direction local p=a.Positions[b.Key]
 local available=o.Remaining
 if o.ReduceOnly then available=(p and p.Direction~=side) and math.min(available,p.Quantity) or 0 end
 local touch=internal and internal.FillTicks or self:_touch(b,side)
 local marketable=o.Type=="Market" or (o.Price-touch)*side>=0
 if marketable and available>0 then self:_playerFill(o,touch,available) end
 if o.Remaining==0 then self:_retire(o,"Filled")
 elseif o.Type=="Market" or (o.ReduceOnly and marketable) then
  o.Cancelled+=o.Remaining o.Remaining=0 self:_retire(o,o.Filled>0 and "Partial / IOC" or "Nothing to close")
 else
  local index=self:_restingIndex() index[b.Key]=index[b.Key] or {} index[b.Key][o.Id]=true
 end
 a.Revision+=1
 local average=o.Filled>0 and o.Notional/o.Filled or nil
 return true,{Id=o.Id,Filled=o.Filled,Remaining=o.Remaining,Cancelled=o.Cancelled,Average=average,Status=o.Status,
  Slippage=average and (average-o.Reference*b.Spec.Tick)*side or 0}
end
function Engine:_trade(b,incoming,resting,qty)

 self.NextTrade+=1
 local trade={Id=self.NextTrade,Time=self.Time,Step=self.Step,Contract=b.Key,Price=price,Ticks=tick,Quantity=qty,
  Buyer=incoming.Direction==1 and incoming.Owner or resting.Owner,Seller=incoming.Direction==-1 and incoming.Owner or resting.Owner}

  end

  if not candle or candle.Time~=bucket then

   table.insert(series,candle) if #series>self.Config.MaxCandles then table.remove(series,1) end
  end

  local account=self.Accounts[id]
  if account.Player and not account.Locked and self:Summary(account).Equity<=0 then
   account.Locked=true account.Liquidating=true account.Revision+=1

  if p and not p.Triggered then

   elseif p.Target and (price-p.Target)*p.Direction>=0 then reason="Take profit" end
   if reason then
    p.Triggered=reason
    if reason=="Stop loss" then p.Target=nil else p.Stop=nil end
    table.insert(self.PendingStops,{Owner=id,Contract=b.Key,Position=p.Id})
   end
  end

end
-- `internal` is engine-only (never from a client request): FillTicks sets a take-profit fill price.

function Engine:ProcessStops()

   -- A player's take profit is a limit at the target: it fills at the target once a trade reaches it.
   local internal
   if a.Player and p.Triggered=="Take profit" and p.Target then internal={FillTicks=math.round(p.Target/self.Books[item.Contract].Spec.Tick)} end
   self:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=item.Contract,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=math.min(p.Quantity,a.Player and self.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity or 10000),Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true},internal)
  end
 end
 self:_triggerStops()
end
-- Triggered stop entries become ordinary market orders, in order-id sequence. While its market order is
-- checked the stop stops reserving capacity, so Submit applies every current rule once (contract cap, buying
-- power, depletion, order limits): a stop can never fill past the cap. A rejection ends the stop. If the
-- book is momentarily empty, the unfilled rest stays triggered (and reserved) and retries for a few
-- simulated seconds, like a resting stop-market order, before it is cancelled for lack of liquidity.
Engine.StopRetrySeconds=5
function Engine:_triggerStops()
 local ready={}
 for _,ids in pairs(self:_stopIndex()) do for id in pairs(ids) do local o=self.Orders[id] if o and o.Triggered then table.insert(ready,id) end end end
 if #ready==0 then return end
 table.sort(ready)
 for _,id in ipairs(ready) do
  local o=self.Orders[id]
  if o then
   local a=self.Accounts[o.Owner] local b=self.Books[o.Contract]
   a.OpenOrders[o.Id]=nil
   local ok,result=self:Submit(o.Owner,{Contract=o.Contract,Direction=o.Direction,Quantity=o.Remaining,Type="Market",
    StopTicks=o.StopTicks,TargetTicks=o.TargetTicks,Link=o.Link})
   local filled=ok and result.Filled or 0
   if filled>0 then
    o.Remaining-=filled o.Cancelled+=filled -- converted into the child market order that holds the fill
    o.Converted=(o.Converted or 0)+filled o.ConvertedNotional=(o.ConvertedNotional or 0)+result.Average*filled
   end
   local waiting=ok and o.Remaining>0 and self.Time-o.Triggered<Engine.StopRetrySeconds and not a.Locked
   if waiting then a.OpenOrders[o.Id]=true
   else
    local status=not ok and "Rejected" or o.Remaining>0 and (filled>0 or o.Converted) and "Partial / IOC" or o.Remaining>0 and "No liquidity" or "Triggered"
    local unfilled=o.Remaining o.Cancelled+=unfilled o.Remaining=0
    a.OpenOrders[o.Id]=true self:_retire(o,status)
    local done=o.Converted or 0
    a.Triggers=a.Triggers or {}
    table.insert(a.Triggers,1,{Id=o.Id,Contract=o.Contract,Direction=o.Direction,Quantity=o.Original,Price=o.Price*b.Spec.Tick,Ok=done>0,
     Filled=done,Average=done>0 and o.ConvertedNotional/done or nil,Message=not ok and result or unfilled>0 and ("No liquidity for "..unfilled) or nil,Time=self.Time})
    if #a.Triggers>8 then table.remove(a.Triggers) end
   end
   a.Revision+=1
  end
 end
end
function Engine:AdvanceClock(dt)
 self.Time+=dt self.Step+=1
 for _,id in ipairs(sortedKeys(self.Orders)) do
  local o=self.Orders[id] if o.Expires and o.Expires<=self.Time then self:Cancel(o.Owner,id) end
 end
 for _,id in ipairs(self.AccountOrder) do
  local a=self.Accounts[id]
  if a.House then continue end -- counterparty of player fills; it has no risk limits and never trades
  local summary=self:Summary(a)
  if not next(a.Positions) then a.Liquidating=nil end
  if summary.Equity<=0 or (not a.Player and summary.Margin>math.max(0,summary.Equity)*1.05) then
   if summary.Equity<=0 then a.Locked=true if a.Player and not a.Depleted then a.Depleted=true a.DepletedAt=self.Time end end
   a.Liquidating=true self:CancelAll(id)
   for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do local p=a.Positions[key] if p then p.Triggered=a.Locked and "Account depleted" or "Margin liquidation" p.Stop=nil p.Target=nil end end
  end
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   local p=a.Positions[key] if p and p.Triggered then table.insert(self.PendingStops,{Owner=id,Contract=key,Position=p.Id}) end
  end
 end
 self:ProcessStops()
end
-- Atomic amendment: validate before touching the working order. Preserve its identity, quantity,
-- attached protection and copy links. A newly marketable price follows normal player-limit fills.
function Engine:AmendOrder(owner,request)
 local a=self.Accounts[owner]
 local o=type(request)=="table" and self.Orders[request.OrderId]
 if not a or not a.Player or not o or o.Owner~=owner or o.Contract~=request.Contract or o.Type~="Limit" or o.Remaining<=0 then
  return false,"Limit order is no longer working."
 end
 if a.Locked or a.Liquidating then return false,"Account depleted. Limit order cannot be changed." end
 local b=self.Books[o.Contract] local tick=b.Spec.Tick
 if not finite(request.ExpectedPrice) or math.abs(request.ExpectedPrice-o.Price*tick)>tick*.00001 or request.ExpectedQuantity~=o.Remaining then
  return false,"Limit order changed while dragging. Please try again."
 end
 local price=request.Price
 if not finite(price) or price<=0 or math.abs(price/tick-math.round(price/tick))>.00001 then return false,"Limit price must use the instrument tick size." end
 local ticks=math.round(price/tick) local last=b.Last or b.Reference
 if math.abs(ticks-last)>last*self.Config.PriceBandFraction then return false,"Limit is outside the price band." end
 if not o.ReduceOnly and self:OrderCapacity(a,o.Contract,o.Direction,o.StopTicks,o.Id)<o.Remaining then return false,"Account contract limit changed. Cancel another order first." end
 o.Price=ticks o.Time=self.Time
 self:_playerOrder(a,b,o)
 return true,string.format("Limit %s moved to %.2f%s",o.Direction==1 and "Buy" or "Sell",price,o.Remaining==0 and " · filled" or "")
end
function Engine:AmendProtection(owner,request)
 local a=self.Accounts[owner]
 if not a or type(request)~="table" then return false,"Unknown account." end
 local field=request.Protection
 if field~="Stop" and field~="Target" then return false,"Invalid protection." end
 local b=self.Books[request.Contract] local p=a.Positions[request.Contract]
 if not b or not p or p.Id~=request.OrderId or p.Triggered or not p[field] or a.Locked then
  return false,"Protection already triggered, cancelled or position closed."
 end
 if not finite(request.ExpectedPrice) or math.abs(request.ExpectedPrice-p[field])>b.Spec.Tick*0.00001 then
  return false,"Protection changed while dragging. Please try again."
 end
 local price=request.Price local tick=b.Spec.Tick
 if not finite(price) or price<=0 or math.abs(price/tick-math.round(price/tick))>0.00001 then
  return false,"Protection price must use the instrument tick size."
 end
 price=math.round(price/tick)*tick
 local last=(b.Last or b.Reference)*tick
 if math.abs(price-last)>last*self.Config.PriceBandFraction then return false,"Protection is outside the price band." end
 local distance=(price-last)*p.Direction
 if (field=="Stop" and distance>=0) or (field=="Target" and distance<=0) then
  return false,field=="Stop" and "Keep SL beyond the current price on the loss side." or "Keep TP beyond the current price on the profit side."
 end
 -- A valid stop may sit beyond the account's equity. Depletion is enforced from
 -- actual execution prices, independently of the configured protection level.
 p[field]=price a.Revision+=1
 return true,string.format("%s moved to %.2f.",field=="Stop" and "SL" or "TP",price)
end
function Engine:CancelProtection(owner,id,field)
 if field~="Stop" and field~="Target" then return false,"Invalid protection." end
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local p=self.Accounts[owner].Positions[key]
  if p and p.Id==id and not p.Triggered then p[field]=nil self.Accounts[owner].Revision+=1 return true,"Protection cancelled." end
 end
 return false,"Protection already triggered or position closed."
end
function Engine:Snapshot(owner,key,timeframe,full)
 local a=self.Accounts[owner] local positions,orders={},{}
 for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local p=a.Positions[symbol]
  if p then
   positions[symbol]=copy(p)
   positions[symbol].Unrealized=((self.Books[symbol].Last or self.Books[symbol].Reference)*self.Books[symbol].Spec.Tick-p.Entry)*p.Quantity*p.Direction*self.Books[symbol].Spec.Multiplier
   for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"}) do if p[field] then table.insert(orders,{Id=p.Id,Contract=symbol,Quantity=p.Quantity,
    Kind=field=="Stop" and "Stop loss" or "Take profit",Price=p[field],Protection=field,Status=p.Triggered or "Armed"}) end end
  end
 end
 for _,id in ipairs(sortedKeys(a.OpenOrders)) do
  local o=self.Orders[id] if o then table.insert(orders,{Id=id,Contract=o.Contract,Quantity=o.Remaining,Original=o.Original,Filled=o.Filled,
   Kind=(o.Type=="Stop" and "Stop " or "Limit ")..(o.Direction==1 and "Buy" or "Sell"),Type=o.Type,Direction=o.Direction,
   Price=o.Price*self.Books[o.Contract].Spec.Tick,Status=o.Type=="Stop" and (o.Triggered and "Triggered" or "Armed") or o.Filled>0 and "Partial" or "Working"}) end
 end
 local quotes={}
 for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local b=self.Books[symbol] local tick=b.Spec.Tick
  if b.Spec.CloseOnly and not a.Positions[symbol] then continue end
  local bid=b.Bids[1] and b.Bids[1].Price*tick local ask=b.Asks[1] and b.Asks[1].Price*tick
  quotes[symbol]={Last=b.Last and b.Last*tick,Open=b.Open and b.Open*tick,Bid=bid,Ask=ask,Spread=bid and ask and ask-bid,
   Volume=b.Volume,TradeCount=b.Up+b.Down,Recent={},Depth={Bids={},Asks={}}}
  for i=math.max(1,#b.Recent-15),#b.Recent do table.insert(quotes[symbol].Recent,b.Recent[i]*tick) end
  for _,side in ipairs({"Bids","Asks"}) do for i=1,math.min(5,#b[side]) do local l=b[side][i] table.insert(quotes[symbol].Depth[side],{Price=l.Price*tick,Quantity=l.Quantity}) end end
 end
 local series=self.Books[key].Candles[timeframe] local candles={}
 for i=full and 1 or math.max(1,#series-1),#series do table.insert(candles,copy(series[i])) end
 -- Current maximum new order per instrument and side (the same rule Submit enforces), for the ticket and chart menu.
 local capacity
 if a.Player then
  capacity={}
  for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   if not self.Books[symbol].Spec.CloseOnly then
    local buy=a.Locked and 0 or (self:OrderCapacity(a,symbol,1)) local sell=a.Locked and 0 or (self:OrderCapacity(a,symbol,-1))
    capacity[symbol]={Buy=buy,Sell=sell}
   end
  end
 end
 return {Seed=self.Seed,Time=self.Time,Step=self.Step,Quotes=quotes,Positions=positions,Orders=orders,History=a.History,Fills=a.Fills,
  Base=a.Base,Summary=self:Summary(a),Contract=key,Timeframe=timeframe,Candles=candles,Full=full,Revision=a.Revision,Locked=a.Locked,
  Capacity=capacity,Limit=a.Player and math.min(a.Limit,self.Config.MaxPlayerInventory) or nil,Triggers=a.Triggers}
end
function Engine:Audit()
 local cash,equity,inventory,volume=0,0,{},0
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do inventory[key]=0 end
 for _,id in ipairs(self.AccountOrder) do
  local a=self.Accounts[id] cash+=a.CashFlow equity+=self:Summary(a).Equity-a.Base
  assert(math.abs(a.Balance-a.Base-a.Realized)<0.001,"Balance / realized reconciliation")
  local st=a.Stats
  if a.Player and type(st)=="table" then
   assert(math.abs(a.Realized-(st.Gains-st.Loss+st.UntrackedNet))<0.01,"Lifetime stats / realized reconciliation")
   assert(st.Trades==st.Wins+st.Losses+st.Even,"Lifetime stats trade classification")
  end
  for key,p in pairs(a.Positions) do inventory[key]+=p.Quantity*p.Direction end
 end
 assert(math.abs(cash)<0.01,"Notional cash is not conserved") assert(math.abs(equity)<0.01,"Total marked P&L is not zero")
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  assert(inventory[key]==0,"Inventory is not conserved") local b=self.Books[key] volume+=b.Volume
  for _,tf in ipairs(self.Config.Timeframes) do assert((b.CandleVolume[tf[1]] or 0)==b.Volume,"Candle volume mismatch") end
  for _,side in ipairs({b.Bids,b.Asks}) do
   for _,l in ipairs(side) do local total=0 local arrival=0 for _,o in ipairs(l.Orders) do
    assert(o.Remaining>0 and self.Orders[o.Id]==o,"Stale resting order") assert(o.Id>arrival,"FIFO violated") arrival=o.Id total+=o.Remaining
   end assert(total==l.Quantity,"Level quantity mismatch") end
  end
  assert(not b.Bids[1] or not b.Asks[1] or b.Bids[1].Price<b.Asks[1].Price,"Crossed resting book")
 end
 for _,list in ipairs({self.Orders,self.OrderArchive}) do for _,o in pairs(list) do assert(o.Original==o.Filled+o.Remaining+o.Cancelled,"Order quantity mismatch") end end
 assert(volume==self.TotalVolume,"Total volume mismatch")
 return {CashError=cash,EquityError=equity,Inventory=inventory,Volume=volume,Trades=self.NextTrade,Hash=self.TradeHash}
end
return Engine

-- Read-only transport with one request in flight, late-response rejection and visible-only refresh.
local Client={} Client.__index=Client
function Client.new(preview,data)
 return setmetatable({Preview=preview,Data=data,Tab="Global",Cache={},CacheAt={},Visible=false,Alive=true,Serial=0,
  Changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),NextRefresh=0},Client)
end
function Client.Stale(packet)
 local result=table.clone(packet);result.State="Stale"
 if result.Your then
  result.Your=table.clone(result.Your);result.Your.Rank=nil
  result.Your.Status=result.Your.Eligible and "Outside top 100" or "Complete a trade to join"
 end
 result.Rows={}
 for _,row in ipairs(packet.Rows or {})do local r=table.clone(row);r.Rank=nil;table.insert(result.Rows,r)end
 return result
end
function Client:Cached(tab)
 local data=self.Cache[tab]
 if not data then return nil end
 if os.clock()-(self.CacheAt[tab]or 0)>(tab=="Global"and 45 or 10)or(tab=="Global"and data.SavedAt and os.time()-data.SavedAt>120)then return Client.Stale(data)end
 return data
end
function Client:Fetch(force)
 if not self.Alive or self.Preview or self.Busy or not self.Visible then return end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now<(self.RequestAt or 0)+2.1 then
  if force then self.NextRefresh=math.min(self.NextRefresh,now+2.2) end
  return
 end
 self.RequestAt=now;self.Busy=true;self.Serial+=1
 local serial,tab=self.Serial,self.Tab
 local settled=false
 if not self.Cache[tab] then self.Data={Tab=tab,State="Loading",Rows={}};self.Changed:Fire() end
 local function finish(packet)
  if not self.Alive or serial~=self.Serial or settled then return end
  settled=true
  self.Busy=false
  if type(packet)~="table" or packet.State=="Throttled" then packet={Tab=tab,State="Error",Rows={}} end
  if packet.State=="Error" and self.Cache[tab] then packet=Client.Stale(self.Cache[tab])end
  if packet.State=="Ready" or packet.State=="Empty" then self.Cache[tab]=packet;self.CacheAt[tab]=os.clock()end
  if self.Tab==tab then self.Data=packet;self.NextRefresh=os.clock()+((packet.State=="Error" or packet.State=="Loading")and 10 or tab=="Global"and 45 or 10);self.Changed:Fire()
  else self.NextRefresh=0;self:Fetch(true) end
 end
 task.delay(12,function()if self.Alive and self.Busy and serial==self.Serial then finish({Tab=tab,State="Error",Rows={}})end end)
 task.spawn(function()
  local remote=script.Parent:FindFirstChild("LeaderboardRequest")
  local ok,packet=pcall(function()return remote and remote:InvokeServer(tab)end)
  finish(ok and packet or nil)
 end)
end
function Client:SetVisible(visible)
 if self.Visible==visible then return end
 self.Visible=visible
 if visible then self.Data=self:Cached(self.Tab)or self.Data;self.NextRefresh=0;self:Fetch(true) end
end
function Client:Select(tab)
 if self.Tab==tab then return end
 self.Tab=tab;self.Data=self:Cached(tab) or {Tab=tab,State="Loading",Rows={}};self.NextRefresh=0;self.Changed:Fire();self:Fetch(true)
end
function Client:Step()
 if self.Visible and os.clock()>=self.NextRefresh then self:Fetch() end
end
function Client:Destroy()self.Alive=false;self.Serial+=1;self.Changed:Destroy()end
return Client

 local n=0
 local function check(ok,msg)n+=1;assert(ok,msg)end
 for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do
  local spec=Config.Contracts[key]

   for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do

     local p=Protection.Resolve(spec,qty,amount,spec.Last,side,field)

     check(math.abs(p.Dollars-amount)<=spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*qty/2+.001 or p.Ticks==1,"nearest valid total")
     check((p.Price-spec.Last)*side*(field=="Stop"and -1 or 1)>0,"correct protection side")
    end
   end
  end
 end
 for _,bad in ipairs({0,-1,math.huge,0/0})do check(not Protection.Resolve(Config.Contracts.ES,1,bad),"invalid dollars")end
 local e=E.new(Config,41)

 local id=r.Id local o=e.Orders[id]
 check(o.StopTicks==3 and o.TargetTicks==5,"server converts totals using quantity")

  local old=o.Price local accepted=F.Perform(e,owner,r)

 end
 reject("other",req(price+1))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+.1))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+1,price+2))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+1,nil,2))
 reject(a.Id,req(spec.Last*2))
 a.Locked=true;reject(a.Id,req(price+1));a.Locked=false

 check(o.Price*spec.Tick==price+1 and o.Id==id and o.Remaining==3 and o.StopTicks==3,"preserves identity, quantity, protection")
 price+=1
 check(F.Perform(e,a.Id,req(spec.Last+10)),"marketable amendment accepted")

 local p=a.Positions.ES

 check(math.abs((p.Target-p.Entry)*spec.Multiplier*3-187.5)<.001,"chart target reflects effective total")

-- Lifetime Stats regression suite (server only). Studio: StudioDiagnostics:Invoke("StatsTests").
-- Every case uses an isolated in-memory engine; the live exchange and saved data are never touched.
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Funded=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local TradeStats=require(script.Parent.TradeStats)
local Shared=game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign
local Default=require(Shared.MarketConfig)
local Ladder=require(Shared.ProgressionConfig)
local StatsView=require(Shared.StatsView)
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Tests={}
local function deep(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=deep(x) end return r end
local function exchange(seed)
 local c=table.clone(Default) c.MaxTradeHistory=100000 c.MaxOrderHistory=100000
 local e=Engine.new(c,seed or 77)
 e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,100000,0.99,false) e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,100000,0.99,false)
 return e,Funded.new(e,deep(Ladder),c)
end
local function quote(e,side,price,qty,key)
 local ok,r=e:Submit("maker",{Contract=key or "ES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Limit",Price=price}) assert(ok,tostring(r)) return r
end
-- Player fills are off-book and never consume quotes, so clear the fixture maker's quotes first: this
-- participant-to-participant print is what moves the market price.
local function mark(e,price,key)
 e:CancelAll("maker") quote(e,-1,price,1,key) local ok,r=e:Submit("taker",{Contract=key or "ES",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) assert(ok and r.Filled==1,"mark failed")
end
local function place(e,id,side,qty,key)
 local ok,res=Funded.Perform(e,id,{Action="Place",Contract=key or "ES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Market"}) assert(ok,tostring(res))
 assert(res.Filled==qty,"expected a full fill, got "..tostring(res.Filled)) return res
end
-- One round trip: open at entry, close at exit (both fully filled by the maker).
local function round(e,id,side,entry,exit,qty)
 quote(e,-side,entry,qty or 1) place(e,id,side,qty or 1) quote(e,side,exit,qty or 1) place(e,id,-side,qty or 1)
end
local function near(a,b,msg) assert(a~=nil and math.abs(a-b)<1e-6,(msg or "value").." expected "..tostring(b).." got "..tostring(a)) end
local function scope(stats,key) for _,x in ipairs(stats.Scopes) do if x.Key==key then return x end end for _,x in ipairs(stats.Legacy) do if x.Key==key then return x end end end
local function json(v) return Http:JSONEncode(v) end
-- Ledger reconciliation used by every case: stats agree with balances, realized totals, trade history and the
-- completed-trade counter, and the engine audit (which now also checks stats) passes.
local function reconcile(e,f,uid)
 local p=f:Profile(uid) local stats=f:Stats(uid) local all=scope(stats,"ALL").Life
 near(all.Net,f:Earned(p),"All funded net vs ledger")
 near(all.Net,all.Gains-all.Loss+all.UntrackedNet,"gains - losses + untracked")
 assert(all.Trades==all.Wins+all.Losses+all.Even,"classification")
 for _,id in ipairs(p.Ledger) do
  local a=e.Accounts[id] local s=a.Stats
  near(a.Realized,s.Gains-s.Loss+s.UntrackedNet,id.." stats vs realized")
  if s.Origin~="Partial" then
   assert((a.CompletedTrades or 0)==s.Trades,id.." counter "..tostring(a.CompletedTrades).." vs stats "..s.Trades)
   if #a.History<e.Config.MaxAccountHistory then
    local sum=0 for _,h in ipairs(a.History) do sum+=h.Pnl end
    near(sum,a.Realized,id.." history sum") assert(#a.History==s.Trades,id.." history rows vs trades")
   end
  end
 end
 e:Audit()
 return stats
end

  assert(StatsView.Coverage(TradeStats.Finish(TradeStats.Include(TradeStats.Empty(),e2,b)),tostring):find("unknown number"))
  -- Idempotent: repeated restores/rebuilds never change migrated stats.

  for _=1,3 do TradeStats.Reconcile(e2,b,os.time()+100) Funded.new(e2,deep(Ladder),e2.Config) end

  return {Complete="12 trades rebuilt exactly (Recovered)",Trimmed="60 tracked + 15 earlier (≥, net "..string.format("%.2f",s2.UntrackedNet)..") labelled",NoCounter="unknown count labelled",Idempotent=true}
 end)
 test("Saved blown attempts migrate once; old loss-limit breaches are not blown",function()

ServerScriptService.MarketReign.TradeSta:
-- Authoritative lifetime trading statistics, stored on each player account inside the exchange checkpoint.
-- A "completed trade" is one closing execution: exactly one row of the account's Trade History. A partial
-- close records the contracts it closed; the rest count when they close. A reversal counts its closing part.
-- Counters are updated by MarketEngine on the same execution that changes Balance/Realized, so they save and
-- restore atomically with the ledger. Display history is bounded (MaxAccountHistory); these counters are not.
local Stats={Version=1,EvenCents=0}
local EPS=0.005 -- half a cent: reconciliation tolerance for floating-point P&L

-- Calendar days are [00:00:00, 24:00:00) UTC, from the server's close timestamp.
-- Simulation HH:MM:SS is deliberately never treated as a historical calendar date.
local function dayRow()
 return {Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Net=0}
end
function Stats.TrackDay(s,row)
 local stamp=row.ClosedAt
 if type(stamp)=="number" and stamp==stamp and stamp>0 and stamp<1e12 then
  local key=tostring(math.floor(stamp/86400))
  local d=s.Days[key] or dayRow() s.Days[key]=d
  local pnl=row.Pnl or 0 local cents=math.round(pnl*100)
  d.Trades+=1 d.Net+=pnl
  if cents>0 then d.Wins+=1 elseif cents<0 then d.Losses+=1 else d.Even+=1 end
  if pnl>0 then d.Gains+=pnl elseif pnl<0 then d.Loss-=pnl end
  d.Best=math.max(d.Best or pnl,pnl) d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or pnl,pnl)
  s.FirstClosedAt=math.min(s.FirstClosedAt or stamp,stamp)
 end
 s.DayLastTradeId=math.max(s.DayLastTradeId or 0,row.TradeId or 0)
end
function Stats.EnsureDays(s,rows)
 if s.DayV~=1 then s.DayV=1 s.Days={} s.DayLastTradeId=0 end
 -- Also repairs dates retained after an older server updated lifetime counters but not days.
 local last=s.DayLastTradeId or 0
 for i=#(rows or {}),1,-1 do local row=rows[i]
  if type(row.TradeId)=="number" and row.TradeId>last and row.TradeId<=(s.LastTradeId or 0) then Stats.TrackDay(s,row) end
 end
end

function Stats.New(origin,now)
 return {V=Stats.Version,Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Best=nil,Worst=nil,LastTradeId=0,
  UntrackedNet=0,UntrackedTrades=0,CountUnknown=false,Origin=origin or "Live",Since=now,DayV=1,Days={},DayLastTradeId=0}
end
-- Classify by the cent: a result that rounds to $0.00 is break-even. Sums use the exact values so that
-- Gains - Loss equals the ledger's realized total.
function Stats.Add(s,row)
 Stats.EnsureDays(s)
 Stats.TrackDay(s,row)
 local pnl=row.Pnl or 0
 local cents=math.round(pnl*100)
 s.Trades+=1
 if cents>Stats.EvenCents then s.Wins+=1 elseif cents<-Stats.EvenCents then s.Losses+=1 else s.Even+=1 end
 if pnl>0 then s.Gains+=pnl elseif pnl<0 then s.Loss-=pnl end
 if s.Best==nil or pnl>s.Best then s.Best=pnl end
 if s.Worst==nil or pnl<s.Worst then s.Worst=pnl end
 if type(row.TradeId)=="number" and row.TradeId>s.LastTradeId then s.LastTradeId=row.TradeId end
end
function Stats.Tracked(s) return s.Gains-s.Loss end

-- Depletion is recorded per attempt, once. New executions set Depleted when the engine latches Locked at
-- $0 equity. Saved attempts from before this marker existed are classified from their final state.
function Stats.MarkDepletion(engine,a)
 if a.Depleted or a.Breached or not a.Locked or not a.Player then return end
 local equity=engine:Summary(a).Equity
 -- Checkpoint v3 reopened every positive-equity account that older loss rules had locked, so a current
 -- (not retired) locked account is depleted. A retired attempt still holding most of its capital was
 -- restarted under the earlier loss-limit rules and is reported separately, not as blown.
 if equity<=0 or not a.Retired or a.Balance<=a.Base*0.5 then a.Depleted=true
 else a.Breached="Earlier loss limit" end
end

-- Idempotent migration + drift repair. Safe to call on every restore.
--  * Accounts without Stats are rebuilt from their saved Trade History. When the rows reconcile with the
--    ledger (realized total, and the completed-trade counter when present) and the history was never trimmed,
--    the rebuild is complete ("Recovered"). Otherwise the unmatched part is kept as an untracked remainder
--    ("Partial") so Net realized still equals the ledger, and the UI labels the breakdown period.
--  * Accounts with Stats pick up any retained rows newer than LastTradeId (e.g. written by an older server
--    build), and any remaining mismatch is moved into the untracked remainder. Nothing is ever counted twice.
function Stats.Reconcile(engine,a,now)
 if not a.Player then return nil end
 local max=engine.Config.MaxAccountHistory or 60
 local rows=a.History or {}
 local s=a.Stats local fresh=type(s)~="table" or s.V~=Stats.Version
 if fresh then s=Stats.New("Recovered",now) a.Stats=s end
 Stats.EnsureDays(s,rows)
 -- History is newest first. Skip the scan when the newest row is already counted.
 local newest=rows[1]
 if fresh or (newest and type(newest.TradeId)=="number" and newest.TradeId>s.LastTradeId) then
  for i=#rows,1,-1 do
   local h=rows[i]
   if fresh or (type(h.TradeId)=="number" and h.TradeId>s.LastTradeId) then Stats.Add(s,h) end
  end
 end
 local gap=a.Realized-(Stats.Tracked(s)+s.UntrackedNet)
 local ledger=a.CompletedTrades
 if fresh then
  local trimmed=#rows>=max
  local countKnown=(ledger==nil and not trimmed) or ledger==s.Trades
  if math.abs(gap)<EPS and countKnown then
   s.Origin=#rows>0 and "Recovered" or "Live"
   -- The completed-trade counter predates some saves; a complete rebuild makes it exact.
   if ledger==nil and s.Trades>0 then a.CompletedTrades=s.Trades end
  else
   s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=now
   s.UntrackedNet=gap
   s.UntrackedTrades=math.max(0,(ledger or #rows)-s.Trades)
   -- A counter that started from an already-trimmed history can itself undercount. Say so.
   s.CountUnknown=trimmed and ledger~=s.Trades
  end
 else
  if math.abs(gap)>=EPS then s.UntrackedNet+=gap s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=s.PartialSince or now end
  local counted=s.Trades+s.UntrackedTrades
  if ledger and ledger>counted then s.UntrackedTrades+=ledger-counted s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=s.PartialSince or now end
 end
 Stats.MarkDepletion(engine,a)
 return s
end

-- Aggregation used by every Stats scope. Open P&L comes from the live engine summary of open positions.
function Stats.Empty()
 return {Attempts=0,Blown=0,Breached=0,Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Net=0,Open=0,
  UntrackedNet=0,UntrackedTrades=0,CountUnknown=false,Partial=false,Recovered=false,Since=nil,Days={}}
end
function Stats.Include(agg,engine,a)
 local s=a.Stats or Stats.Reconcile(engine,a,os.time())
 Stats.EnsureDays(s,a.History)
 for key,day in pairs(s.Days) do
  local d=agg.Days[key] or dayRow() agg.Days[key]=d
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do d[k]+=day[k] end
  if day.Best then d.Best=math.max(d.Best or day.Best,day.Best) end
  if day.Worst then d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or day.Worst,day.Worst) end
 end
 if s.FirstClosedAt then agg.FirstClosedAt=math.min(agg.FirstClosedAt or s.FirstClosedAt,s.FirstClosedAt) end
 agg.Attempts+=1
 if a.Depleted then agg.Blown+=1 elseif a.Breached then agg.Breached+=1 end
 for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","UntrackedNet","UntrackedTrades"}) do agg[k]+=s[k] end
 agg.Net+=a.Realized
 if not a.Retired then agg.Open+=engine:Summary(a).Unrealized end
 if s.Best~=nil and (agg.Best==nil or s.Best>agg.Best) then agg.Best=s.Best end
 if s.Worst~=nil and (agg.Worst==nil or s.Worst<agg.Worst) then agg.Worst=s.Worst end
 if s.Origin=="Partial" then
  agg.Partial=true agg.CountUnknown=agg.CountUnknown or s.CountUnknown
  if s.PartialSince and (agg.Since==nil or s.PartialSince<agg.Since) then agg.Since=s.PartialSince end
 elseif s.Origin=="Recovered" then agg.Recovered=true end
 return agg
end
-- Derived values, computed once on the server so every client shows the same numbers.
function Stats.Finish(agg,datedOnly)
 if math.abs(agg.UntrackedNet)<EPS then agg.UntrackedNet=0 end
 agg.Total=agg.Net+agg.Open
 agg.WinRate=agg.Trades>0 and agg.Wins/agg.Trades or nil
 agg.AllTrades=agg.Trades+agg.UntrackedTrades
 if not agg.CountUnknown and agg.AllTrades>0 then agg.Average=agg.Net/agg.AllTrades agg.AverageScope="All"
 elseif agg.Trades>0 then agg.Average=(agg.Gains-agg.Loss)/agg.Trades agg.AverageScope="Tracked" end
 agg.AvgWin=agg.Wins>0 and agg.Gains/agg.Wins or nil
 agg.AvgLoss=agg.Losses>0 and agg.Loss/agg.Losses or nil
 agg.WinLossRatio=agg.AvgLoss and agg.AvgLoss>0 and (agg.AvgWin or 0)/agg.AvgLoss or nil
 agg.ProfitFactor=agg.Loss>0 and agg.Gains/agg.Loss or nil
 agg.NoLosses=agg.Trades>0 and agg.Gains>0 and agg.Loss==0
 local dated=Stats.Empty() local days,wins,lossDays,dayTrades,best=0,0,0,0,nil
 for _,day in pairs(agg.Days or {}) do
  days+=1 dayTrades+=day.Trades
  if math.round(day.Net*100)>0 then wins+=1 end
  if math.round(day.Net*100)<0 then lossDays+=1 end
  best=math.max(best or day.Net,day.Net)
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do dated[k]+=day[k] end
 end
 agg.UndatedTrades=math.max(0,agg.AllTrades-dayTrades)
 agg.DayCount=days agg.WinningDays=wins agg.LosingDays=lossDays agg.BestDay=best
 agg.DailyComplete=agg.UndatedTrades==0 and not agg.CountUnknown and not agg.Partial
 agg.DayWinRate=agg.DailyComplete and days>0 and wins/days or nil
 agg.BestDayShare=agg.DailyComplete and best and best>0 and agg.Net>=EPS and best/agg.Net or nil
 if not datedOnly then
  dated.Days=agg.Days dated.FirstClosedAt=agg.FirstClosedAt
  dated.Attempts=agg.Attempts dated.Blown=agg.Blown dated.Breached=agg.Breached
  agg.Dated=Stats.Finish(dated,true)
 end
 -- Day buckets remain on the saved account; only compact derived results cross the network.
 agg.Days=nil
 return agg
end
return Stats
ServerScriptService.MarketReign.Depletio:
-- Account-blown (depletion) notice, status and restart regression suite (server only).
-- Studio: StudioDiagnostics:Invoke("DepletionTests"). Uses isolated engines; never touches the live exchange.
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Funded=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Shared=game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign
local Default=require(Shared.MarketConfig)
local Ladder=require(Shared.ProgressionConfig)
local Tests={}
local function deep(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=deep(x) end return r end
local function exchange()
 local c=table.clone(Default) c.MaxTradeHistory=100000 c.MaxOrderHistory=100000
 local e=Engine.new(c,91)
 e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,100000,0.99,false) e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,100000,0.99,false)
 return e,Funded.new(e,deep(Ladder),c)
end
local function quote(e,side,price,qty,key)
 local ok,r=e:Submit("maker",{Contract=key or "ES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Limit",Price=price}) assert(ok,tostring(r)) return r
end
-- Player fills are off-book and never consume quotes, so clear the fixture maker's quotes first: this
-- participant-to-participant print is what moves the market price.
local function mark(e,price,key)
 e:CancelAll("maker") quote(e,-1,price,1,key) local ok,r=e:Submit("taker",{Contract=key or "ES",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) assert(ok and r.Filled==1,"mark failed")
end
local function place(e,id,side,qty,key,extra)
 local r={Action="Place",Contract=key or "ES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Market"}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {}) do r[k]=v end
 local ok,res=Funded.Perform(e,id,r) assert(ok,tostring(res)) return res,r
end
local function tier(view,id) local found;for _,row in ipairs(view.Accounts) do if row.Tier==id then found=row end end return found end
local function near(a,b,msg) assert(math.abs(a-b)<1e-6,(msg or "value").." expected "..b.." got "..a) end
local function depletions(events)
 local list={} for _,ev in ipairs(events or {}) do if ev.Kind=="Depleted" then table.insert(list,ev) end end return list
end
local function playerAccounts(e,uid)
 local n=0 for id in pairs(e.Accounts) do if id:sub(1,#("player:"..uid..":"))=="player:"..uid..":" then n+=1 end end return n
end

function Tests.Run()
 local report={} local function test(name,fn)
  local ok,result=pcall(fn) table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and result or tostring(result)})
 end
 test("Exactly $0 equity blows the account and announces it once",function()
  local e,f=exchange() f:Start("1") local id=f:Owner("1")
  quote(e,-1,5825,1) place(e,id,1,1) mark(e,5725)
  local a=e.Accounts[id] near(e:Summary(a).Equity,0,"equity") assert(a.Locked,"Zero equity did not deplete")
  local list=depletions(f:TakeEvents("1")) assert(#list==1,"Expected one depletion notice")
  local ev=list[1] assert(ev.Tier=="F5K:1" and ev.Name=="$5K Funded #1" and ev.Event=="F5K:1" and ev.Attempt==1 and ev.Size==5000)
  near(ev.Equity,0,"event equity") assert(ev.Closing and not ev.CanRestart,"No liquidity yet: notice must report closing")
  quote(e,1,5725,1) e:AdvanceClock(.25)
  assert(not a.Positions.ES) near(a.Realized,-5000,"realized")
  local row=tier(f:View("1"),"F5K") assert(row.Depleted and row.Breached and not row.Closing and row.CanRestart and row.DepletionEvent=="F5K:1")
  assert(#depletions(f:TakeEvents("1"))==0,"Depletion announced twice")
  e:Audit()
  return "Equity $0.00 → notice F5K:1 (closing), then liquidated −$5,000, restart available, no repeat"
 end)
 test("Negative equity blows the account",function()
  local e,f=exchange() f:Start("2") local id=f:Owner("2")
  quote(e,-1,5825,1) place(e,id,1,1) mark(e,5700)
  local a=e.Accounts[id] near(e:Summary(a).Equity,-1250,"equity") assert(a.Locked)
  local ev=depletions(f:TakeEvents("2"))[1] assert(ev) near(ev.Equity,-1250,"event equity")
  quote(e,1,5700,1) e:AdvanceClock(.25) near(a.Realized,-6250,"realized") near(a.Balance,-1250,"balance")
  return "Equity −$1,250 → blown; liquidated at −$6,250 realized"
 end)
 test("Negative open P&L with positive equity is not blown",function()
  local e,f=exchange() f:Start("3") local id=f:Owner("3")
  quote(e,-1,5825,1) place(e,id,1,1) mark(e,5760) e:AdvanceClock(.25)
  local a=e.Accounts[id] near(e:Summary(a).Unrealized,-3250,"open P&L") near(e:Summary(a).Equity,1750,"equity")
  assert(not a.Locked and a.Positions.ES,"Positive equity liquidated")
  local row=tier(f:View("3"),"F5K") assert(not row.Depleted and not row.Breached and not row.CanRestart and row.Closing==nil)
  assert(#depletions(f:TakeEvents("3"))==0,"Notice raised for open loss")
  assert(not f:Restart("3","F5K"),"Restarted an account in good standing")
  return "Open P&L −$3,250 / equity $1,750: no notice, no restart"
 end)
 test("Liquidation reports closing status until it closes at the market price, then allows restart",function()
  local e,f=exchange() f:Start("4") local id=f:Owner("4") local a=e.Accounts[id]
  quote(e,-1,5825,3) place(e,id,1,3) mark(e,5790)
  -- Depletion latches on the reaching trade; the close runs on the next scheduler step.
  assert(a.Locked and a.Positions.ES.Quantity==3,"Position should be closing after the depleting trade")
  local row=tier(f:View("4"),"F5K") assert(row.Depleted and row.Closing and not row.CanRestart and row.Positions==1 and row.OpenContracts==3)
  local ok,msg=f:Restart("4","F5K") assert(not ok,"Restart allowed while closing")
  assert(#depletions(f:TakeEvents("4"))==1)
  local lastTick=e.Books.ES.Last
  e:AdvanceClock(.25) -- an empty bid side still closes, at the last market trade, without printing one
  row=tier(f:View("4"),"F5K") assert(not a.Positions.ES and not row.Closing and row.CanRestart and row.OpenContracts==0)
  assert(e.Books.ES.Last==lastTick,"Liquidation moved the market")
  assert(#depletions(f:TakeEvents("4"))==0,"Status changes re-announced the depletion")
  near(a.Realized,-5250,"realized")
  return "3 open (closing) → flat at the 5,790 market price in one step; restart only when flat; one notice"
 end)
 test("Restart succeeds once, restores capital and keeps losses/history",function()
  local e,f=exchange() f:Start("5") local id=f:Owner("5") local a=e.Accounts[id]
  quote(e,-1,5825,3) place(e,id,1,3) mark(e,5790) quote(e,1,5790,3) e:AdvanceClock(.25)
  assert(a.Locked and not a.Positions.ES) f:TakeEvents("5")
  local history=#a.History
  local ok1=f:Restart("5","F5K") local ok2,duplicate=f:Restart("5","F5K")
  assert(ok1 and not ok2 and playerAccounts(e,"5")==2,"Duplicate restart created another attempt")
  e:AdvanceClock(.25) assert(not f:Restart("5","F5K"),"Fresh attempt restarted again")
  local fresh=e.Accounts[f:Owner("5")] assert(fresh.Id~=id and fresh.Balance==5000 and fresh.Base==5000 and not fresh.Locked)

ServerScriptService.MarketReign.Leaderbo:
-- This game persists EVERY funded profile in one fenced shared-exchange checkpoint.
-- Publish a complete top-100 projection, atomically, instead of racing per-user ordered writes.
-- A lower score can evict a previous winner correctly; ties at the cutoff are deterministic.
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
local Service={} Service.__index=Service
Service.RefreshSeconds=45
function Service.Scope(studio) return studio and "Studio" or "Live" end
function Service.new(options)
 options=options or {}
 return setmetatable({Store=options.Store,Studio=options.Studio,Now=options.Now or os.time,
  Cache=nil,ReadAt=0,NextRead=0,NextWrite=0,Pending=nil,Reading=false,Writing=false,Failures=0},Service)
end
function Service:_store()
 if not self.Store then self.Store=game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("GetFunded_Leaderboard_v1",Service.Scope(self.Studio)) end
 return self.Store
end
function Service:Queue(projection)
 if not projection or self.LastProjection==projection then return end
 self.LastProjection=projection
 if not self.Pending or projection.WorldId~=self.Pending.WorldId or projection.Sequence>self.Pending.Sequence then self.Pending=projection end
end
function Service:Flush()
 local pending=self.Pending
 if self.Writing or not pending or self.Now()<self.NextWrite then return false end
 self.Writing=true
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  return self:_store():UpdateAsync("top100",function(old)
   if old then
    assert(old.Version==1 and old.WorldId==pending.WorldId,"Leaderboard belongs to another exchange")
    if old.Sequence>=pending.Sequence then return nil end -- fences delayed/stale writers, including losses
   end
   return {Version=1,WorldId=pending.WorldId,Sequence=pending.Sequence,SavedAt=pending.SavedAt,Rows=pending.Rows}
  end)
 end)
 self.Writing=false
 if ok then
  self.Failures=0;self.WriteError=nil;self.NextWrite=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds
  if self.Pending==pending then self.Pending=nil end
  if result then
   -- An overlapping read may already have seen the next owner's newer snapshot.
   if not self.Cache or (result.WorldId==self.Cache.WorldId and result.Sequence>=self.Cache.Sequence)then
    self.Cache=result;self.ReadAt=self.Now();self.NextRead=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds;self.ReadError=nil
   end
  else self.NextRead=0 end
 else
  self.Failures+=1;self.WriteError=tostring(result)
  self.NextWrite=self.Now()+math.min(45,5*2^math.min(self.Failures-1,4))
 end
 return ok
end
function Service:Read()
 local now=self.Now()
 if self.Reading or now<self.NextRead then return self.Cache end
 self.Reading=true;self.NextRead=now+Service.RefreshSeconds
 local ok,record=pcall(function()return self:_store():GetAsync("top100")end)
 self.Reading=false
 if ok and record and (record.Version~=1 or type(record.Rows)~="table" or type(record.SavedAt)~="number" or type(record.Sequence)~="number") then ok=false;record="Invalid leaderboard snapshot" end
 if ok then
  -- Do not regress a cache if a read overlaps a newer successful publish.
  if not record then if not self.Cache then self.ReadAt=now end
  elseif not self.Cache or (record.WorldId==self.Cache.WorldId and record.Sequence>=self.Cache.Sequence) then self.Cache=record;self.ReadAt=now end
  self.ReadError=nil
 else self.ReadError=tostring(record);self.NextRead=now+10 end
 return self.Cache
end
function Service:Names(rows)
 self.NameCache=self.NameCache or {};self.NameRetry=self.NameRetry or 0
 local missing={}
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  local cached=self.NameCache[row.UserId]
  if cached then row.Name=cached.Name;row.DisplayName=cached.DisplayName
  elseif not row.Name and row.UserId>0 then table.insert(missing,row.UserId) end
 end
 if #missing==0 or self.Now()<self.NameRetry then return end
 self.NameRetry=self.Now()+60
 local ok,infos=pcall(function()return game:GetService("UserService"):GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync(missing)end)
 if ok then
  for _,info in ipairs(infos) do self.NameCache[info.Id]={Name=info.Username,DisplayName=info.DisplayName} end
  for _,row in ipairs(rows)do local info=self.NameCache[row.UserId];if info then row.Name=info.Name;row.DisplayName=info.DisplayName end end
 end
end
function Service:Global(own)
 self:Read()
 local record=self.Cache
 local stale=record and (self.Now()-record.SavedAt>120 or self.ReadError~=nil or self.WriteError~=nil)
 local rows={}
 for _,r in ipairs(record and record.Rows or {}) do
  local row=table.clone(r);if stale then row.Rank=nil end;table.insert(rows,row)
 end
 self:Names(rows)
 local state=not record and (self.ReadError and "Error" or "Loading") or stale and "Stale" or #rows==0 and "Empty" or "Ready"
 return {Tab="Global",State=state,Rows=rows,Your=Ranking.Standing(own,rows,record~=nil and not stale),
  SavedAt=record and record.SavedAt,RefreshSeconds=Service.RefreshSeconds,Studio=self.Studio==true}
end
function Service:Server(funded,players,player)
 local rows={}
 for _,p in ipairs(players) do table.insert(rows,Ranking.Row(funded,tostring(p.UserId),p)) end
 rows=Ranking.Sort(rows)
 local own=Ranking.Standing(Ranking.Row(funded,tostring(player.UserId),player),rows,true)
 return {Tab="Server",State=#rows==0 and "Empty" or "Ready",Rows=rows,Your=own,RefreshSeconds=10,Studio=self.Studio==true}
end
return Service

-- Pure projection of the authoritative funded ledger. Never accepts client scores.
local Ranking={Limit=100}
function Ranking.Row(funded,uid,identity)
 local p=funded:Profile(uid)
 local row={UserId=tonumber(uid),Name=identity and identity.Name or p and p.PlayerName,
  DisplayName=identity and identity.DisplayName or p and p.DisplayName,Cents=0,Eligible=false,Tier="—",TierSize=0}
 if not row.UserId or row.UserId%1~=0 then return nil end
 if not p then return row end
 local profit=funded:Earned(p)
 assert(profit==profit and math.abs(profit)<9e13,"Invalid funded profit")
 row.Cents=math.round(profit*100)
 for _,id in ipairs(p.Ledger) do
  local a=funded.Engine.Accounts[id]
  if a and a.Tier and funded.Tiers[a.Tier] and ((a.CompletedTrades or 0)>0 or #(a.History or {})>0 or a.Realized~=0) then
   row.Eligible=true;break
  end
 end
 for _,id in ipairs(funded.Order) do
  if p.Tiers[id] then row.Tier=funded.Tiers[id].Short;row.TierSize=funded.Tiers[id].Size end
 end
 return row
end
function Ranking.Sort(rows,limit)
 local result,seen={},{}
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  if row and row.Eligible and not seen[row.UserId] then seen[row.UserId]=true;table.insert(result,table.clone(row)) end
 end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b) if a.Cents~=b.Cents then return a.Cents>b.Cents end return a.UserId<b.UserId end)
 while limit and #result>limit do table.remove(result) end
 for i,row in ipairs(result) do row.Rank=i end
 return result
end
function Ranking.Capture(funded)
 local rows={}
 for uid in pairs(funded.Engine.Profiles) do
  local row=Ranking.Row(funded,uid)
  -- Studio's synthetic negative user ids are allowed only by its separate store scope.
  if row then table.insert(rows,row) end
 end
 return Ranking.Sort(rows,Ranking.Limit)
end
function Ranking.Standing(own,rows,verified)
 own=table.clone(own);own.Rank=nil
 if not own.Eligible then own.Status="Complete a trade to join";return own end
 own.Status="Outside top 100"
 if verified then
  for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
   if row.UserId==own.UserId and row.Cents==own.Cents then own.Rank=row.Rank;own.Status="#"..row.Rank;break end
  end
 end
 return own
end
return Ranking

-- Funded-account ladder, onboarding and copy-trading regression suite (server only).
-- Studio: StudioDiagnostics:Invoke("FundedTests"). Uses isolated engines; never touches the live exchange.
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Funded=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Shared=game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign
local Default=require(Shared.MarketConfig)
local Ladder=require(Shared.ProgressionConfig)
local Tests={}
local function deep(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=deep(x) end return r end
local function progression(unlocks)
 local c=deep(Ladder)
 for id,value in pairs(unlocks or {}) do for _,t in ipairs(c.Tiers) do if t.Id==id then t.Unlock=value end end end
 return c
end
local function exchange(unlocks)
 local c=table.clone(Default) c.MaxTradeHistory=100000 c.MaxOrderHistory=100000
 local e=Engine.new(c,55)
 e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,100000,0.99,false) e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,100000,0.99,false)
 return e,Funded.new(e,progression(unlocks),c)
end
local function quote(e,side,price,qty,key)
 local ok,r=e:Submit("maker",{Contract=key or "ES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Limit",Price=price}) assert(ok,tostring(r)) return r
end
-- One bot-to-bot execution moves the last traded price. Player fills are off-book and never consume
-- quotes, so the fixture maker's quotes are cleared first.
local function mark(e,price,key)
 e:CancelAll("maker") quote(e,-1,price,1,key) local ok,r=e:Submit("taker",{Contract=key or "ES",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) assert(ok and r.Filled==1,"mark failed")
end
local function place(e,id,side,qty,key,extra)
 local r={Action="Place",Contract=key or "ES",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Market"}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {}) do r[k]=v end
 local ok,res=Funded.Perform(e,id,r) assert(ok,tostring(res)) return res,r
end
local function playerAccounts(e,uid)
 local n=0 for id in pairs(e.Accounts) do if id:sub(1,#("player:"..uid..":"))=="player:"..uid..":" then n+=1 end end return n
end
local function tier(view,id)
 for _,row in ipairs(view.Accounts) do if row.Tier==id then return row end end
 for _,row in ipairs(view.Tiers) do if row.Key==id then return row end end
end
local function near(a,b) return math.abs(a-b)<1e-6 end

function Tests.Run()
 local report={} local function test(name,fn)
  local ok,result=pcall(fn) table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and result or tostring(result)})
 end
 test("First join creates nothing; Start creates exactly one $5K starter",function()
  local e,f=exchange()
  assert(f:Join("101")==nil and f:Owner("101")==nil and f:View("101").New,"New player received an implicit account")
  local ok,_,created=f:Start("101") assert(ok and created)
  local again,_,createdAgain=f:Start("101") assert(again and not createdAgain,"Second Start created an account")
  f:Start("101") assert(playerAccounts(e,"101")==1,"Duplicate starter account")
  local a=e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")]
  assert(a.Base==5000 and a.Balance==5000 and a.LossLimit==5000 and a.Limit==5 and a.Group=="player:101")
  local v=f:View("101")
  assert(v.Started and v.Active=="F5K:1" and v.Capital==5000 and v.Earned==0 and v.Tutorial=="Pending" and v.Next.Key=="F10K")
  assert(not v.Copy.Enabled and not v.CopyAvailable,"Copy trading must start off")
  assert(f:Flag("101","TutorialSkipped") and f:View("101").Tutorial=="Skipped")
  return "One starter account; repeated Start is idempotent; tutorial state saved"
 end)
 test("Only net realized profit unlocks; starting balance and open P&L never count",function()
  local e,f=exchange() f:Start("7") local id=f:Owner("7")
  quote(e,-1,5825,2) place(e,id,1,2)
  mark(e,5900)
  assert(e:Summary(e.Accounts[id]).Unrealized>700,"Expected a large open gain")
  f:Evaluate("7") assert(f:View("7").Earned==0 and tier(f:View("7"),"F10K").State=="Locked","Unrealized gain unlocked an account")
  assert(f:TakeEvents("7")==nil)
  quote(e,1,5855,2) assert(Funded.Perform(e,id,{Action="Close",Contract="ES"}))
  assert(near(e.Accounts[id].Realized,3000) and near(e.Accounts[id].Balance,8000))
  f:Evaluate("7") local v=f:View("7")
  assert(near(v.Earned,3000),"Earned must exclude the $5,000 starting balance")
  assert(tier(v,"F10K").State=="Unlocked" and tier(v,"F25K").State=="Locked" and v.Next.Key=="F25K")
  local events=f:TakeEvents("7")
  assert(events and #events==2 and events[1].Kind=="FirstProfit" and events[2].Kind=="Unlocked" and events[2].Tier=="F10K")
  f:Evaluate("7") assert(f:TakeEvents("7")==nil,"Unlock announced twice")
  local saved=f:Profile("7").Tiers.F10K.UnlockedAt f:Evaluate("7") assert(f:Profile("7").Tiers.F10K.UnlockedAt==saved)

ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.StatsView:
-- Stats page: lifetime trading performance across funded accounts and restarts. Every number is computed and
-- persisted by the server (TradeStats / FundedAccounts:Stats). This module only lays it out, using the
-- terminal's Fredoka typography, outlined values, colourful cards and glossy controls (passed in via ctx).
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
local Charts=require(script.Parent.StatsCharts)
local View={}
local LEFT,CENTER,RIGHT=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local TOP=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
local AtEnd=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
local FONT=Enum.Font.FredokaOne

local function commas(n)
 local raw=tostring(math.floor(math.abs(n or 0)+0.5))
 return ((n or 0)<0 and "-" or "")..raw:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","")
end
local function plural(n,word) return commas(n).." "..word..(n==1 and "" or "s") end
local function pct(rate) return rate and string.format("%.1f%%",rate*100) or "—" end
local function dateText(t)
 if type(t)~="number" then return nil end
 local ok,v=pcall(function() return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(t):FormatLocalTime("ll","en-us") end)
 return ok and v or nil
end
local function measure(value,size,width) return TextService:GetTextSize(value,size,FONT,Vector2.new(math.max(1,width),10000)).Y end
View.Commas=commas

-- Scopes in display order: All funded, each tier with attempts, then legacy accounts.
function View.Resolve(data,state)
 local list={}
 for _,x in ipairs(data and data.Scopes or {}) do table.insert(list,x) end
 local scope
 for _,x in ipairs(list) do if x.Key==state.StatsScope then scope=x end end
 scope=scope or list[1]
 local period=state.StatsPeriod=="Dated" and "Dated" or (scope and state.StatsPeriod=="Current") and "Current" or "Life"
 local agg=scope and (period=="Dated" and scope.Life.Dated or scope[period])
 return scope,agg or (scope and scope.Life),period,list
end
-- Open P&L moves every market update. It is taken from the server's live portfolio summary (the same values the
-- dashboard shows). Only active attempts can hold positions, so lifetime and current open P&L are identical.
function View.OpenFor(scope,pf,agg)
 if not scope then return 0 end
 if pf then
  if scope.Kind=="All" then return pf.Open or 0 end
  local total,seen=0,{}
  for _,r in ipairs(pf.Accounts or {}) do
   if r.Tier==scope.Key and not seen[r.Key] then seen[r.Key]=true;total+=r.Unrealized or 0 end
  end
  return total
 end
 return agg and agg.Open or 0
end
function View.Describe(scope,agg,period)
 if period=="Dated" then return "Only closed trades with saved calendar dates, across all attempts (including blown accounts). All six cards use this same dated history." end
 local a=agg.Attempts or 0
 local blown=agg.Blown>0 and (", including "..commas(agg.Blown).." blown") or ""
 local text
 if scope.Kind=="All" and period=="Life" then
  text="Every funded attempt you have traded: "..plural(a,"attempt")..blown..". Includes previous attempts and restarts."
 elseif scope.Kind=="All" then
  text="Only the "..plural(a,"attempt").." you are trading now. Blown and retired accounts are excluded."
 elseif period=="Life" then
  text=scope.Name.." · all "..plural(a,"attempt")..blown..". Restarting opens a new attempt; earlier results stay in these totals."
 else
  text=scope.Name.." · all "..plural(a,"usable account").." in this tier. Blown and retired accounts are excluded."
 end
 if (agg.Breached or 0)>0 then
  text..=" "..plural(agg.Breached,"earlier attempt").." ended under the old loss-limit rules and "..(agg.Breached==1 and "is" or "are").." not counted as blown."
 end
 return text
end
function View.Coverage(agg,signed)
 if agg.Partial then
  local since=dateText(agg.Since)
  local count=agg.UntrackedTrades>0 and (" across "..(agg.CountUnknown and "at least " or "")..plural(agg.UntrackedTrades,"earlier trade"))
   or (agg.CountUnknown and " across an unknown number of earlier trades" or "")
  return "Earlier results without a full breakdown (net "..signed(agg.UntrackedNet)..count..") remain in Total P&L. Ratios are unavailable for this incomplete scope; use Dated history for a consistent tracked scope."
 elseif agg.Recovered then
  return "Includes earlier trades rebuilt from your saved trade history."
 end
 return nil
end

function View.Draw(ctx,x,y,w,h,mobile)
 local C,SC=ctx.C,ctx.SC
 local s=ctx.State local data=ctx.Data local pf=ctx.Portfolio
 local signed,money=ctx.signed,ctx.money
 local sc=ctx.make("ScrollingFrame","Stats",ctx.Canvas,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),
  BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=4,ScrollBarImageColor3=C.Cyan,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y})
 local cw=w-(mobile and 6 or 14) local narrow=cw<600 local gap=mobile and 10 or 14
 local soft=Color3.fromRGB(214,234,255) local gold=Color3.fromRGB(255,214,104)
 local function valueColor(v,onCard) if math.abs(v or 0)<0.005 then return C.Text end return v>0 and (onCard and SC.Green or C.Green) or (onCard and SC.Red or C.Red) end
 local function sgn(v) if math.abs(v or 0)<0.005 then return "$0.00" end return signed(v) end
 -- Header
 ctx.heading(sc,"Title","Your Stats",0,0,cw,narrow and 34 or 40,narrow and 26 or 34)
 local sub=ctx.text(sc,"Subtitle",narrow and "Server-calculated results" or "Closed trades · saved across restarts · calculated by the exchange server",0,narrow and 34 or 42,cw,24,14,ctx.Muted,FONT)
 sub.TextTruncate=AtEnd
 local yy=narrow and 70 or 80
 local function finish(state)
  sc.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,yy)
  sc:SetAttribute("State",state)
  return sc
 end
 -- Loading, error and empty states share one card.
 local function stateCard(name,title,body,label,fn,variant)
  local tx=mobile and 16 or 104 local tw=cw-tx-(mobile and 16 or 24)
  local bodyH=measure(body,15,tw)+4
  local ch=math.max(mobile and 0 or 132,18+30+8+bodyH+(label and 60 or 12))
  local c=ctx.card(sc,name,0,yy,cw,ch,Color3.fromRGB(10,44,118),Color3.fromRGB(4,24,70),C.Cyan,not mobile)
  if not mobile then ctx.icon(c,"Unrealized",18,(ch-72)/2,72) end
  ctx.value(c,"Heading",title,tx,16,tw,30,narrow and 19 or 24,C.Text,mobile).TextXAlignment=LEFT
  local b=ctx.text(c,"Body",body,tx,52,tw,bodyH,15,soft,FONT) b.TextWrapped=true b.TextYAlignment=TOP
  if label then
   local bw=math.min(tw,260)
   local btn=ctx.gloss(ctx.button(c,"StateAction",label,tx,ch-54,bw,42,fn,C.Raised,C.Text,16),variant or "Purple")
   btn.Corners.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,14)
  end
  yy+=ch+gap
 end
 if not data or data.Loading then
  local waiting=ctx.Status and not ctx.CanTrade
  stateCard("StatsLoading",waiting and "Waiting for the exchange" or "Loading your stats…",
   waiting and (tostring(ctx.Status)..". Your saved results are safe; stats appear as soon as the exchange is ready.") or "Fetching your lifetime results from the exchange server.",
   "Retry",ctx.retry,"Cyan")
  return finish(waiting and "Waiting" or "Loading")
 end
 if data.Error then
  stateCard("StatsError","Stats unavailable",data.Error,"Retry",ctx.retry,"Cyan")
  return finish("Error")
 end
 local scope,agg,period,list=View.Resolve(data,s)
 if data.New or not scope then
  stateCard("StatsEmpty","No stats yet","Start a funded account and close your first trade. Every completed trade, win, loss and blown account is then tracked here for good, including across restarts.",
   "Start a Funded Account",ctx.start,"Purple")
  return finish("Empty")
 end
 -- Scope tabs: All funded · each tier · legacy practice.
 local cols=narrow and math.min(#list,3) or math.min(#list,7)
 local tabH=narrow and 40 or 44
 local tabW=(cw-8*(cols-1))/cols
 if not narrow then tabW=math.min(tabW,190) end
 for i,item in ipairs(list) do
  local col,row=(i-1)%cols,math.floor((i-1)/cols)
  local label=item.Kind=="All" and (narrow and "All funded" or "All Funded Accounts") or item.Short
  local b=ctx.button(sc,"TabScope"..item.Key,label,col*(tabW+8),yy+row*(tabH+8),tabW,tabH,function() s.StatsScope=item.Key ctx.refresh() end,C.Raised,C.Text,narrow and 14 or 16)
  ctx.control(b,item==scope)
 end
 yy+=math.ceil(#list/cols)*(tabH+8)+2
 if scope then
  local segW=(cw-16)/3
  local current=narrow and "Usable only" or "All usable accounts"
  for i,p in ipairs({{"Life",narrow and "Lifetime" or "Lifetime · all attempts"},{"Current",current},{"Dated","Dated history"}}) do
   local b=ctx.button(sc,"TabPeriod"..p[1],p[2],(i-1)*(segW+8),yy,segW,38,function() s.StatsPeriod=p[1] ctx.refresh() end,C.Raised,C.Text,narrow and 11 or 15)
   ctx.control(b,period==p[1])
  end
  yy+=46
 end
 -- What this view includes (previous attempts, restarts, legacy) and how complete its history is.
 local eyebrow=(scope.Kind=="All" and "ALL FUNDED ACCOUNTS" or string.upper(scope.Name))
  .."  ·  "..(period=="Dated" and "DATED HISTORY" or period=="Life" and "LIFETIME · INCLUDES RESTARTS" or "CURRENT ATTEMPTS").." · UTC DAYS"
 local describe=View.Describe(scope,agg,period)
 local coverage=View.Coverage(agg,sgn)
 if (agg.UndatedTrades or 0)>0 or agg.CountUnknown then
  coverage=(coverage and coverage.." " or "").."Earlier trades have no calendar date. Daily metrics are unavailable for this scope; Dated history applies the same dated-trades filter to all six cards."
 elseif period=="Dated" and agg.FirstClosedAt then
  coverage="From "..os.date("!%Y-%m-%d",agg.FirstClosedAt).." through today (UTC). Earlier undated results remain in Lifetime."
 end
 if not coverage and agg.AllTrades==0 then
  coverage="No completed trades in this view yet. Close a position and its result appears here within a second."
 end
 local bw=cw-32 local ds=15
 local dh=measure(describe,ds,bw)+4 local chH=coverage and measure(coverage,ds-1,bw)+4 or 0
 local eh=measure(eyebrow,14,bw)+6
 local bh=12+eh+6+dh+(coverage and chH+6 or 0)+12
 local banner=ctx.card(sc,"ScopeInfo",0,yy,cw,bh,Color3.fromRGB(10,52,140),Color3.fromRGB(4,26,78),C.Cyan,false)

local Pool=require(script.Parent.ChartPaintPool)
return function()
 local root=Instance.new("Frame") local pool=Pool.new(root)
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  local function mark(x,identity,animate)
   pool:Begin(animate)
   local object=pool:Get("Frame","Candle",root)
   pool:Props(object,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,20)},identity)
   pool:Finish();return object
  end
  local candle=mark(0,60,false)
  assert(mark(0,60,true)==candle and #root:GetChildren()==1,"Unchanged paint must reuse its object")
  mark(100,60,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==0,"Animation must start at the existing geometry")
  pool:Step(.02);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset>0 and candle.Position.X.Offset<100,"Intermediate geometry expected")
  pool:Step(.06);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==100 and not next(pool.Moving),"Must settle exactly on the target")
  mark(200,60,true);pool:Step(.02)
  mark(300,120,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==300,"Never animate a reused slot from a different candle")
  mark(400,120,true);pool:Step(.01);mark(450,120,false)
  assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==450 and not next(pool.Moving),"Dragging must follow the pointer without tween lag")
  mark(500,120,true);pool:Step(.01);pool:Begin(true);pool:Finish()
  assert(not candle.Visible)
  mark(500,120,true);assert(candle.Visible and candle.Position.X.Offset==500,"Hidden animation cannot resume with stale geometry")
  pool:Begin(false);local row=pool:Dash(root,0,30,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local count=#root:GetDescendants();local first=row:GetChildren()[1];local position=first.Position
  pool:Begin(false);local same=pool:Dash(root,0,80,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  assert(row==same and #root:GetDescendants()==count and first.Position==position and row.Position.Y.Offset==80,"Dash movement must move only the parent")
  pool:Begin(false);pool:Dash(root,0,80,300,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local visible=0 for _,child in ipairs(row:GetChildren())do if child.Visible then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible==30,"Resizing must hide surplus dashes")
  -- Keyed objects: a candle keeps its own object whatever order candles are drawn in.
  local keyed=Pool.new(root)
  local function draw(times)
   keyed:Begin(false) local out={}
   for _,t in ipairs(times)do out[t]=keyed:Get("Frame","KeyedCandle",root,t)end
   keyed:Finish() return out
  end
  local a=draw({60,120,180}) local b=draw({120,180,240})
  assert(a[120]==b[120] and a[180]==b[180] and b[240]~=a[60],"Keyed objects follow their identity")
  assert(not a[60].Visible and b[240].Visible,"Keyed objects out of view are hidden")
  local c=draw({60}) assert(c[60]==a[60] and c[60].Visible,"Returning candles reuse their object")
  for _=1,5 do draw({60}) end keyed:Prune(3)
  assert(a[120].Parent==nil and c[60].Parent==root,"Long-unused keyed objects are destroyed")
  return {Passed=true,Cases=10,Checks="Reuse, intermediate motion, exact settlement, candle identity, immediate drag, hidden motion, grouped dash resizing, keyed identity, keyed hiding, pruning"}
 end)
 root:Destroy();if not ok then error(result)end;return result
end

-- One durable record owns both the checkpoint and its writer lease. UpdateAsync fences stale servers.
local Lease={} Lease.__index=Lease
function Lease.new(store,settings,identity,clock)
 return setmetatable({Store=store,Settings=settings,Identity=identity,Now=clock or os.time,Record=nil,Owned=false},Lease)
end
function Lease:Claim()
 local observed
 local result=self.Store:UpdateAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey,function(old)
  if old then assert(old.Version==1,"Unsupported exchange ownership record")end
  observed=old
  local now=self.Now()
  if old and old.LeaseUntil>now and old.Owner~=self.Identity.Token then return nil end
  local nextRecord=old and table.clone(old)or{Version=1,WorldId=self.Identity.WorldId,Generation=0,SaveSequence=0,SavedStep=0}
  if nextRecord.Owner~=self.Identity.Token then nextRecord.Generation+=1 end
  nextRecord.Owner=self.Identity.Token nextRecord.JobId=self.Identity.JobId nextRecord.PlaceId=self.Identity.PlaceId
  nextRecord.LeaseUntil=now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
  return nextRecord
 end)
 self.Record=result or observed
 self.Owned=result~=nil and result.Owner==self.Identity.Token
 return self.Owned,self.Record
end
function Lease:Valid()
 return self.Owned and self.Record~=nil and self.Now()<self.Record.LeaseUntil-self.Settings.SafetySeconds
end
function Lease:Commit(checkpoint,step,release)
 assert(self.Owned and self.Record,"This server does not own the exchange")
 assert(type(checkpoint)=="table"and type(step)=="number","A complete checkpoint is required")
 local generation=self.Record.Generation
 local result=self.Store:UpdateAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey,function(old)
  local now=self.Now()
  if not old or old.Owner~=self.Identity.Token or old.Generation~=generation or old.LeaseUntil<=now or step<old.SavedStep then return nil end
  local nextRecord=table.clone(old)
  nextRecord.Checkpoint=checkpoint nextRecord.SavedStep=step nextRecord.SavedAt=now nextRecord.SaveSequence+=1
  nextRecord.LeaseUntil=release and 0 or now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
  if release then nextRecord.Owner="" nextRecord.JobId=""end
  return nextRecord
 end)
 if not result then self.Owned=false;error("Exchange ownership changed; stale checkpoint rejected")end
 self.Record=result self.Owned=not release
 return result
end
return Lease

local function clone(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=clone(x) end return r end

 local r={Contract=key,Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type=price and "Limit" or "Market",Price=price}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {}) do r[k]=v end
 local ok,result=e:Submit(who,r) assert(ok,tostring(result)) return result
end

 local e=E.new(Config,987) local f=F.new(e,Ladder,Config)

 local e=E.new(config,7239) local p=P.new(e)

 submit(e,"fixture-maker","MES",-1,2,5825)
 submit(e,a.Id,"MES",1,2,nil,{StopTicks=400,TargetTicks=800})

 local results={}

-- Presentation-only chart navigation. Never modifies prices, candles or account state.
-- Time is horizontal (seconds), price is vertical. All inputs are screen deltas in pixels.
local Viewport={}
Viewport.Seconds={["1m"]=60,["5m"]=300,["15m"]=900,["1h"]=3600,["1D"]=86400}
Viewport.MinBars=10          -- deepest zoom-in
Viewport.MaxBars=240        -- absolute zoom-out ceiling (render budget)
Viewport.PixelsPerBar=7      -- readable 3+ px bodies, distinct wicks and space between candles
Viewport.RightMargin=3       -- empty bars to the right of the live candle
Viewport.EaseSeconds=0.07    -- auto-fit price-scale smoothing
Viewport.DefaultBars={Desktop=72,Mobile=36}

-- Practical zoom range: limited by the available history and by how many candles the plot can draw.
function Viewport.Limits(count,width)
 local render=math.clamp(math.floor((width or 800)/Viewport.PixelsPerBar),Viewport.MinBars+10,Viewport.MaxBars)
 local data=math.max(40,math.ceil(count*1.15)+Viewport.RightMargin+2)
 return Viewport.MinBars,math.max(Viewport.MinBars+2,math.min(render,data))
end
-- First index whose candle time is >= time (binary search; candles are time ordered).
local function lowerBound(candles,time)
 local lo,hi=1,#candles+1
 while lo<hi do local mid=(lo+hi)//2 if candles[mid].Time<time then lo=mid+1 else hi=mid end end
 return lo
end
Viewport.LowerBound=lowerBound

function Viewport.Resolve(state,candles,timeframe,tick,mobile,levels,width)
 if #candles==0 then return nil end
 local interval=Viewport.Seconds[timeframe]
 local minBars,maxBars=Viewport.Limits(#candles,width)
 state.Bars=math.clamp(state.Bars or (mobile and Viewport.DefaultBars.Mobile or Viewport.DefaultBars.Desktop),minBars,maxBars)
 state.Interval=interval
 local latest,earliest=candles[#candles].Time,candles[1].Time
 if state.Right==nil then state.Right=latest+Viewport.RightMargin*interval state.Follow=true end
 -- Following: new candles scroll the view by exactly the time they add. Detached: the view never moves.
 if state.Follow and state.Latest and latest~=state.Latest then state.Right+=latest-state.Latest end
 state.Latest=latest
 local maximum=latest+state.Bars*0.8*interval
 local minimum=math.min(earliest+math.min(6,state.Bars*0.5)*interval,maximum)
 state.Right=math.clamp(state.Right,minimum,maximum)
 local right=state.Right local left=right-state.Bars*interval
 -- One extra candle each side so partially visible bodies are drawn and clipped, not popped.
 local first=lowerBound(candles,left-interval) local last=lowerBound(candles,right+interval)-1
 local visible=table.move(candles,first,math.max(first-1,last),1,{})
 local low,high=math.huge,-math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(visible)do
  if c.Time>=left-interval*0.5 and c.Time<=right+interval*0.5 then low=math.min(low,c.Low) high=math.max(high,c.High) end
 end
 if low==math.huge then local c=candles[math.clamp(first,1,#candles)] low=c.Low high=c.High end
 -- While following, keep the live price and the open position's levels in view.
 if state.Follow then for _,price in ipairs(levels or {})do low=math.min(low,price) high=math.max(high,price) end end
 local padding=math.max(tick*2,(high-low)*0.08)
 local targetLow,targetHigh=low-padding,high+padding
 state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh=targetLow,targetHigh
 local auto=state.AutoY~=false
 local lo,hi
 if auto then
  if not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=targetLow,targetHigh end
  lo,hi=state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh
 else lo,hi=state.Low,state.High end
 if hi-lo<tick then local mid=(lo+hi)/2 lo,hi=mid-tick/2,mid+tick/2 end
 return {Left=left,Right=right,Low=lo,High=hi,Bars=state.Bars,Interval=interval,Data=visible,First=first,
  Earliest=earliest,Latest=latest,Minimum=minimum,Maximum=maximum,MinBars=minBars,MaxBars=maxBars,Tick=tick,
  Follow=state.Follow==true,AutoY=auto,TargetLow=targetLow,TargetHigh=targetHigh,
  Live=state.Follow==true and auto}
end
-- Eases the displayed auto-fit range toward its target. Returns true while still moving.
function Viewport.Ease(state,dt,snap)
 if state.AutoY==false or not state.TargetLow then return false end
 if snap or not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false end
 local range=math.max(1e-9,state.TargetHigh-state.TargetLow)
 local dl,dh=state.TargetLow-state.ShowLow,state.TargetHigh-state.ShowHigh
 if math.abs(dl)<range*0.0005 and math.abs(dh)<range*0.0005 then
  state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false
 end
 local k=1-math.exp(-math.max(0,dt)/Viewport.EaseSeconds)
 state.ShowLow+=dl*k state.ShowHigh+=dh*k
 return true
end
function Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction) return view.Left+(view.Right-view.Left)*fraction end
function Viewport.PriceAt(view,fraction) return view.High-(view.High-view.Low)*fraction end
function Viewport.X(view,time,width) return (time-view.Left)/(view.Right-view.Left)*width end
function Viewport.Y(view,price,height) return (view.High-price)/(view.High-view.Low)*height end
local function refollow(state)
 if state.Latest and state.Interval then state.Follow=state.Right>=state.Latest+state.Interval*0.5 end
end
-- Manual price scale: fix the current range so later changes are explicit.
local function manual(state,view)
 if state.AutoY~=false then state.AutoY=false state.Low,state.High=view.Low,view.High end
end
function Viewport.Pan(state,start,dx,dy,width,height)
 state.Right=math.clamp(start.Right-dx/math.max(1,width)*(start.Right-start.Left),math.min(start.Minimum,start.Maximum),start.Maximum)
 -- Auto-fit keeps the price axis fitted to the candles; a manual scale pans vertically with the pointer.
 if not start.AutoY then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
function Viewport.Zoom(state,view,factor,fraction)
 fraction=math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
 local bars=math.clamp(view.Bars*factor,view.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,view.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction)
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-fraction)*bars*view.Interval
 -- Zooming out reveals more history, not empty future: the right edge never moves past where it was
 -- (or the live candle's usual margin), so the extra room goes to older candles.
 if bars>view.Bars and view.Latest and view.Interval then
  state.Right=math.min(state.Right,math.max(view.Right,view.Latest+Viewport.RightMargin*view.Interval))
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Two-finger gesture: the time under the starting midpoint stays under the current midpoint.
function Viewport.Pinch(state,start,fromFraction,toFraction,ratio,dy,height)
 local bars=math.clamp(start.Bars*ratio,start.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,start.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(start,math.clamp(fromFraction,0,1))
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-toFraction)*bars*start.Interval
 if not start.AutoY and dy then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Y-axis drag: down expands the visible price range (candles shorter), up compresses it (taller).
function Viewport.ScalePrice(state,start,dy,height)
 local factor=math.exp(math.clamp(dy,-2000,2000)/math.max(120,height)*1.6)
 local mid=(start.Low+start.High)/2
 local half=math.clamp((start.High-start.Low)/2*factor,(start.Tick or 0.01)*2,math.max(1,math.abs(mid))*2)
 state.AutoY=false state.Low=mid-half state.High=mid+half
end
function Viewport.AutoFit(state)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.Low,state.High end
 state.AutoY=true state.Low=nil state.High=nil
end
-- Follow the live candle again at the current zoom. A manual scale is re-centred on the live price.
function Viewport.GoLive(state,price)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low and price then
  local half=(state.High-state.Low)/2 state.Low=price-half state.High=price+half
 end
 state.Right=nil state.Follow=true
end
function Viewport.Reset(state)
 table.clear(state)
end
Viewport.Manual=manual
local niceSteps={1,2,2.5,5}
-- Round-number price grid; every label is a multiple of the contract tick.
function Viewport.PriceTicks(low,high,tick,count)
 local range=math.max(high-low,tick) local raw=range/math.max(1,count)
 local magnitude=10^math.floor(math.log10(raw)) local step
 for _,m in ipairs(niceSteps)do if m*magnitude>=raw then step=m*magnitude break end end
 step=step or 10*magnitude
 step=math.max(tick,math.ceil(step/tick-1e-9)*tick)
 local ticks={} local p=math.ceil(low/step-1e-9)*step
 while p<=high+1e-9 and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,p) p+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
local timeSteps={60,120,300,600,900,1800,3600,7200,10800,14400,21600,43200,86400,172800,432000,864000,2592000}
function Viewport.TimeTicks(left,right,interval,count)
 local raw=(right-left)/math.max(1,count) local step=timeSteps[#timeSteps]
 for _,s in ipairs(timeSteps)do if s>=interval and s>=raw then step=s break end end
 local ticks={} local t=math.ceil(left/step)*step
 while t<=right and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,t) t+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
return Viewport
